threads.title_zh: 谷歌发布Gemini 4 Argon模型，四个智能体自主通关《我的世界》
threads.title_en: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon model; four agents autonomously beat Minecraft
threads.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 让四个 Gemini 4 Argon 编程智能体在《我的世界》中自主规划并协作，经过 27 小时、605 次死亡和约 520 美元的 API 成本后击败末影龙，全程使用自行编写的 JavaScript 而非预置游戏工具。
threads.summary_en: Google DeepMind let four Gemini 4 Argon coding agents autonomously plan and collaborate in Minecraft, beating the Ender Dragon after 27 hours, 605 deaths and roughly $520 in API costs, using self-written JavaScript rather than pre-built game tools.
threads.latest_update_zh: Google DeepMind 让四个 Gemini 4 Argon 编程智能体在《我的世界》中自主规划并协作，经过 27 小时、605 次死亡和约 520 美元的 API 成本后击败末影龙，全程使用自行编写的 JavaScript 而非预置游戏工具。
threads.latest_update_en: Google DeepMind let four Gemini 4 Argon coding agents autonomously plan and collaborate in Minecraft, beating the Ender Dragon after 27 hours, 605 deaths and roughly $520 in API costs, using self-written JavaScript rather than pre-built game tools.
threads.background_zh: 末影龙是《我的世界》的最终 Boss，玩家需先找到要塞、激活传送门才能进入末地；本次实验中一名 Agent 通过两次投掷末影之眼，计算出距目标仅 43 米的位置。Mineflayer 是一个用于构建《我的世界》机器人的开源 JavaScript 框架，Agent 借助它读取坐标、背包与周围环境，寻路则由现成插件负责。根据谷歌开发者文档，Gemini 4 Argon 是面向自主多步骤 Agent 的旗舰推理模型，具备 100 万 Token 上下文窗口；Vals AI 列出的价格为每百万输入 Token 4 美元、每百万输出 Token 20 美元。
threads.background_en: The Ender Dragon is Minecraft's final boss, fought in the End dimension after locating a stronghold and activating a portal; in this run one agent threw Eyes of Ender twice to calculate a target about 43 meters away. Mineflayer is an open-source JavaScript framework for building Minecraft bots, which the agents used to read coordinates, inventory and surroundings, while a dedicated plugin handled pathfinding. Gemini 4 Argon is described in Google's developer documentation as a flagship reasoning model built for autonomous multi-step agents with a 1M-token context window, and Vals AI lists it at $4.00 per million input tokens and $20.00 per million output tokens.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Google DeepMind let four Gemini 4 Argon coding agents autonomously plan and collaborate in Minecraft, beating the Ender Dragon after 27 hours, 605 deaths and roughly $520 in API costs, using self-written JavaScript rather than pre-built game tools.
threads.latest_summary_en: Google DeepMind let four Gemini 4 Argon coding agents autonomously plan and collaborate in Minecraft, beating the Ender Dragon after 27 hours, 605 deaths and roughly $520 in API costs, using self-written JavaScript rather than pre-built game tools.
threads.market_impact_zh: 本次实验披露的成本与 Token 消耗数据，为长周期 Agent 推理的经济性提供了一个具体参照，这类信息会通过 AI 算力与自主 Agent 叙事影响加密市场的情绪。事件本身不直接涉及具体协议或代币，其传导路径是围绕 Agent 概念及去中心化算力／推理板块的市场情绪，而非文中描述的任何链上资金流动。
threads.market_impact_en: The run's disclosed cost and token-consumption data provide a concrete reference point for the economics of long-horizon agentic inference, a channel that feeds the prevailing AI-compute and autonomous-agent narratives in crypto markets. There is no direct exposure to a specific protocol or token; the effect runs through sentiment around agent-themed and decentralized compute/inference segments rather than through any on-chain flow described here.

timeline.text_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 从仅面向部分网络安全合作伙伴，扩大至向全球所有付费用户正式开放；可在 Gemini App（Google AI Pro/Ultra）、Antigravity（仅 Ultra）和付费 API 使用；API 首发价每百万输入 2 美元、输出 10 美元，优惠持续至 11 月 30 日后翻倍。谷歌还展示了其视频驱动机器人技能学习和仿真生成能力，ERQA 得分 87%。
timeline.text_en: Gemini 4 Argon expanded from limited availability for selected cybersecurity partners to a general opening for all global paid users; it is available in the Gemini App (Google AI Pro/Ultra), Antigravity (Ultra only), and paid API. Introductory API pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens lasts until Nov 30, after which it doubles. Google also showcased video-driven robot skill learning, simulation generation, and an 87% ERQA score.

threads.title_zh: 美联储加息几近锁定，Clarity法案投票临近
threads.title_en: Federal Reserve Rate Hike Close To A Lock ; Clarity Act Vote Looms : Week Ahead
threads.summary_zh: 9月加息后，美联储未锁定进一步行动；沃什10月16日拒绝提供前瞻指引，市场定价10月加息概率约17%，政策路径仍不确定。
threads.summary_en: After the September hike, the Fed has not locked further action; Warsh on Oct 16 declined forward guidance, with markets pricing about 17% odds of an October hike and the policy path still uncertain.
threads.latest_update_zh: 美联储主席沃什10月16日在曼谷IMF会议期间拒绝预判年内剩余两次议息会议结果，市场对10月加息的概率从约30%降至约17%，美元走低。
threads.latest_update_en: Fed Chair Warsh on Oct 16 at the IMF meetings in Bangkok declined to pre-judge the remaining two rate decisions of the year, cutting October hike odds from about 30% to roughly 17% and weakening the dollar.
threads.background_zh: 联邦基金利率是存款类机构之间隔夜拆借准备金余额的利率，由联邦公开市场委员会以目标区间形式设定，该委员会通常每年召开八次会议；美联储主要通过准备金余额利率等工具把有效利率引导至目标区间内。一个基点等于百分之一的百分点，因此加息25个基点即利率上升0.25个百分点。所谓"点阵图"是一张季度图表，匿名记录每位美联储官员对未来数年政策利率的预测，其中值被市场广泛视为委员会的前瞻指引。
threads.background_en: The federal funds rate is the overnight rate at which depository institutions lend reserve balances to one another, and it is set as a target range by the FOMC, which normally meets eight times a year; the Fed steers the effective rate into that range mainly through the interest on reserve balances. A basis point is one hundredth of a percentage point, so a 25 basis point hike moves the rate by 0.25 percentage points. The "dot plot" is a quarterly chart recording each Fed official's anonymous projection for the policy rate over coming years, and its median is widely read as the committee's forward guidance.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh declined to pre-judge the year's remaining two rate decisions, saying the Fed 'no longer does this,' which cut market-implied odds of an October hike from about 30% to roughly 17% and weakened the dollar.
threads.latest_summary_en: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh declined to pre-judge the year's remaining two rate decisions, saying the Fed 'no longer does this,' which cut market-implied odds of an October hike from about 30% to roughly 17% and weakened the dollar.
threads.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道是流动性与贴现率：更高的联邦基金利率和更鹰派的点阵图路径使美债与现金相对风险资产更具吸引力，从而对比特币和以太坊构成压力——两者在声明发布前后剧烈震荡，最终基本持平。美元、短端美债收益率、对利率敏感的股票板块以及加密衍生品资金费率是受影响最直接的领域，而偏鹰派的点阵图使2026年进一步加息成为影响仓位布局的潜在风险因素。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through liquidity and the discount rate: higher fed funds and a higher dot-plot path make Treasuries and cash more attractive relative to risk assets, which pressures bitcoin and ether — both of which whipsawed around the announcement before settling roughly flat. The dollar, front-end Treasury yields, rate-sensitive equity sectors and crypto derivatives funding are the most directly exposed segments, while the hawkish dot keeps a further 2026 hike as a live risk factor for positioning.

timeline.text_zh: 美联储理事沃勒于10月8日表示，9月加息是数月来多重证据累积的结果，而非单一数据驱动；他称最新数据强化了‘就业稳定、通胀过高’的判断，政策将聚焦通胀；未来可能再加息75个基点，但不锁定节奏，市场预期12月前至少加息一次概率85%，2027年3月前至少加两次概率近80%。
timeline.text_en: Fed Governor Waller said on Oct 8 that the September hike was the result of months of cumulative evidence, not a single data point; he said recent data reinforced 'stable employment, too-high inflation' and that policy will focus on inflation; further hikes of up to 75bp are possible but not locked to consecutive meetings, with markets pricing 85% odds of at least one more hike before December and nearly 80% odds of at least two by March 2027.

timeline.text_en: New report adds: FOMC voted 12-0 to raise rates 25 bps to 3.75%-4% and lifted the 2026 year-end median rate projection to 4.1% from 3.8% in June; Bitcoin spiked to $76,499.99 five minutes after the release and gave back the move within half an hour; Zcash rallied to $1,383.

threads.title_zh: CoreWeave扩大借款计划引发市场不安，高收益债券持续下跌
threads.title_en: CoreWeave扩大借款计划引发市场不安，高收益债券持续下跌
threads.summary_zh: CoreWeave债券仍处困境水平，收益率约15%；其融资担忧已扩散至更广泛的AI高收益债市场，高收益债平均收益率创18个月新高，部分AI基础设施借款人融资条款趋严，市场担心AI垃圾债融资可能阶段性关闭。CoreWeave称偿债能力充足，并探索投资级债务及保险资金渠道。
threads.summary_en: CoreWeave bonds remain at distressed levels with yields around 15%; its financing concerns have spread to the broader AI high-yield market, where average yields hit an 18-month high and some AI infrastructure borrowers face stricter terms, raising fears of a temporary closure in AI junk-debt financing. CoreWeave says it has sufficient debt-service capacity and is exploring investment-grade debt and insurance funding.
threads.latest_update_zh: 彭博社报道称，CoreWeave的融资困境正外溢至更广泛的AI高收益/垃圾债市场：高收益债平均收益率升至8.41%的18个月新高，风险溢价扩至3月以来最高；AI云初创公司Volta Infrastructure的50亿美元杠杆贷款条款被调整，最终收益率超过11%；新AI基础设施借款人可能面临更严格条款，甚至无担保融资成本过高而无法发行。CoreWeave联合创始人称正探索投资级债务市场和保险机构资金，公司称财务状况足以偿债，英伟达CEO黄仁勋亦公开维护其财务健康。
threads.latest_update_en: Bloomberg reported that CoreWeave's financing troubles are spilling into the broader AI high-yield/junk-debt market: average high-yield yields rose to 8.41%, an 18-month high, and risk premiums widened to the highest since March; AI cloud startup Volta Infrastructure's $5 billion leveraged loan terms were revised to a yield above 11%; new AI infrastructure borrowers may face stricter terms or prohibitive unsecured funding costs. CoreWeave's co-founder said the company is exploring investment-grade debt and insurance funding, while CoreWeave said its finances are sufficient to service obligations and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang publicly defended its financial health.
threads.background_zh: CoreWeave 是一家 GPU 加速云服务商，出租英伟达算力用于 AI 训练与推理。高收益债利差——即投资者相对更安全债券所要求的风险补偿——在经济不确定或市场波动时期通常走阔，反映投资者避险情绪上升。AI 基建热潮高度依赖债务融资：报道援引高盛数据显示，今年以来企业已在美元市场发行 1060 亿美元投资级及高收益项目融资债券，不少用于数据中心等 AI 投资，规模接近 2025 年全年 370 亿美元的 3 倍；明年全球相关项目融资债券发行量可能超过 3000 亿美元。
threads.background_en: CoreWeave is a GPU-accelerated cloud provider that rents out Nvidia compute for AI training and inference. High-yield bond spreads — the premium investors demand over safer debt — widen during periods of economic uncertainty or market volatility, signaling increased risk aversion. The AI infrastructure buildout has been financed heavily with debt: Goldman Sachs data cited in the report show companies have issued $106 billion of investment-grade and high-yield project-finance bonds in the dollar market this year, many for data centers, close to three times 2025's full-year total of $37 billion, with global related issuance potentially exceeding $300 billion next year.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Bloomberg reports that CoreWeave's financing concerns are worsening AI junk-debt market conditions, with its high-yield yields reaching 15%, broader high-yield spreads at 18-month highs, and new AI infrastructure borrowers facing stricter terms and potentially prohibitive unsecured funding costs.
threads.latest_summary_en: Bloomberg reports that CoreWeave's financing concerns are worsening AI junk-debt market conditions, with its high-yield yields reaching 15%, broader high-yield spreads at 18-month highs, and new AI infrastructure borrowers facing stricter terms and potentially prohibitive unsecured funding costs.
threads.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于信用条件：若 AI 基建的高收益债融资变得过于昂贵，CoreWeave、Volta 等发行方可能转向可转债、股权、有担保债务及证券化融资，从而抬高数据中心与 GPU 算力建设的资金成本。AI 相关信用风险的这轮重定价会通过风险偏好渠道影响风险资产，包括 AI 主题加密代币，以及扩张计划依赖债市的上市或代币化数据中心与算力运营方。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through credit conditions: if high-yield funding for AI infrastructure becomes prohibitively expensive, issuers such as CoreWeave and Volta may shift toward convertibles, equity, secured debt and securitization, raising the cost of capital for data-center and GPU capacity buildouts. That repricing of AI-related credit risk is a sentiment channel for risk assets, including AI-themed crypto tokens and listed or tokenized data-center and compute capacity operators whose expansion plans depend on debt markets.

CoreWeave's co-founder said the company is exploring investment-grade debt and insurance funding, while CoreWeave said its finances are sufficient to service obligations and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang publicly defended its financial health.

timeline.text_zh: CoreWeave债券价格跌至面值80美分以下，收益率接近15%，达到市场通常视为困境债券的水平；该公司股价本周下跌17%；英伟达过去一周市值蒸发约2700亿美元。投资者正在抛售数据中心债券，市场担忧AI收入不足以支撑巨额债务，安联CIO称数据中心债券迎来“达尔文时刻”。
timeline.text_en: CoreWeave bonds fell below 80 cents on the dollar with yields near 15%, reaching levels typically viewed as distressed; the company's stock dropped 17% this week; Nvidia lost about $270 billion in market value over the past week. Investors are dumping datacenter debt amid doubts that AI revenues can service the sector's massive debt load, with Allianz's CIO calling it a 'Darwin moment' for datacenter bonds.

timeline.text_zh:
ICE Data Services 数据显示，CoreWeave 五年期信用违约掉期（CDS）成本周四一度上涨 74.5 个基点，至 1194.5 个基点，创盘中历史新高，意味着掉期市场定价反映该公司未来五年内违约概率超过 60%。同日，CoreWeave 债券成为美国高收益债券市场跌幅最大的债券之一，此前该公司计划进一步扩大借款规模。

报道将这一走势归因于债券投资者对人工智能融资热潮的不安，这促使市场重新评估部分大型科技公司的信用风险，表现为信用违约保险价格飙升、市场波动加剧以及债券表现疲软。

报道称 CoreWeave 是较早进入人工智能云计算领域的企业，并高度依赖高收益债券市场为其业务扩张融资，因此格外受到投资者关注。CDS 与债券数据来自 ICE Data Services。
timeline.text_en: CoreWeave's expanded borrowing plans drove its five-year credit default swap cost to a record 1194.5 bps — implying over 60% default probability — and made its bonds among the biggest decliners in the US high-yield market.

threads.title_zh: 博通为Anthropic芯片采购安排融资并提供贷款
threads.title_en: Broadcom arranges financing and extends loans for Anthropic chip purchases
threads.summary_zh: 该600亿美元AI芯片融资方案（现称“北极星项目”）已进入银团分销阶段，由美国银行、花旗集团和摩根士丹利牵头分销，其中约420亿美元博通支持的高级担保贷款已启动分销；黑石承诺向约180亿美元次级债务中的90亿美元部分提供资金，并获得超过10%的收益率，该债务以Anthropic未来五年芯片租赁付款为支持。

timeline.text_zh: 美国银行、花旗集团和摩根士丹利已启动向其他银行分销该600亿美元融资方案的份额，银团分销程序已开始；其中约420亿美元博通支持的高级担保贷款已启动分销，180亿美元次级债务将稍后推出。

timeline.text_zh: 博通正在安排一项600亿美元的AI芯片融资方案，其中包括420亿美元的高级担保债务和由黑石集团牵头的180亿美元次级债务，Anthropic是受益方之一。
timeline.text_en: Broadcom is arranging a $60 billion AI chip financing package, including $42B in senior secured debt and $18B in subordinated debt led by Blackstone, with Anthropic among the beneficiaries.

threads.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在向美国议员推销一项尚未公布的草案法案，该法案将允许政府仅在某一前沿模型构成可预见的、迫在眉睫的超过 10 亿美元损失或至少 50 人死亡或重伤风险时，限制其发布或使用，同时要求定期进行独立评估，并将部分州级 AI 安全规则纳入联邦框架。

threads.title_zh: Anthropic称Claude揭示NIST椭圆曲线种子参数来源
threads.title_en: Anthropic says Claude uncovered origin of NIST elliptic-curve seed parameters
threads.summary_zh: Anthropic的内部Claude研究模型还原了NIST椭圆曲线种子参数的可能来源，将其对应到标准随机数生成方式及1997至1998年的时间戳；外部密码学家据称已复现核验，但该工作未破解ECDSA，也未揭示新的曲线漏洞。
threads.summary_en: Anthropic’s internal Claude research model reconstructed the likely origin of NIST elliptic-curve seed parameters, linking them to standard random-number generation and 1997–1998 timestamps; external cryptographers reportedly replicated the check, while the work did not break ECDSA or reveal a new curve vulnerability.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充称，Anthropic内部Claude研究模型在不到30分钟内追溯了五个NSA提供的椭圆曲线种子，并将其对应到1997至1998年的Unix时间戳和一段旧计算机程序；外部密码学家据称已通过复现代码核验该结果。
threads.latest_update_en: The new report adds that an internal Anthropic Claude research model traced five NSA-supplied elliptic-curve seeds in under 30 minutes to 1997–1998 Unix timestamps and an old computer program, and that external cryptographers reportedly checked the finding by replicating the code.
threads.background_zh: 这五个种子是 NSA 提供、并于 1990 年代末被纳入公开标准的椭圆曲线参数的一部分，此次识别出的 Unix 时间戳正对应那一时期。由于这些种子从未被公开解释，它们一直是围绕“政府设计的密码学标准是否可信”这一争论中反复被提及的焦点。
threads.background_en: The five seeds are part of the published parameters for elliptic curves supplied by the NSA and standardized for public use in the late 1990s, when the Unix timestamps now identified were created. Because the seeds were never publicly explained, they became a recurring reference point in debates over whether government-designed cryptographic standards can be trusted.
threads.latest_summary_zh:
据报道，Anthropic 表示其内部一款 Claude 研究模型在不到 30 分钟内追溯出五个由 NSA 提供的椭圆曲线种子的来源，解决了一个悬置约 25 年的密码学问题。这些种子被追溯到一段旧的计算机程序以及 1997 至 1998 年的 Unix 时间戳。

这些种子来源不明，长期引发外界怀疑：这套标准化曲线参数中或许藏有被人为植入的弱点。报道称，追溯结果显示其源自标准的随机数生成方式，而外部密码学家据称已通过复现代码对这一结果进行了核验。

报道称，这项工作由 Anthropic 内部的一款研究模型完成，而非公开发布的产品。The Crypto Times 的另一篇报道还称 Claude 将量子电路的门数量削减了 17 倍，但现有材料未对该说法给出细节。
threads.latest_summary_en:
Anthropic said an internal Claude research model traced the origins of five NSA-supplied elliptic-curve seeds in under 30 minutes, resolving a cryptography question that had stayed open for roughly 25 years, according to reports. The seeds were traced to an old computer program and to Unix timestamps dating from 1997–98.

The seeds' unexplained provenance had long fed suspicion that the standardized curve parameters might conceal a deliberately planted weakness. Reports said the traced origin points to standard random-number generation, a finding that external cryptographers reportedly checked by replicating the code.

Reports said the work was carried out by an internal Anthropic research model rather than a publicly released product. Separate coverage by The Crypto Times also credited Claude with cutting quantum circuit gate counts 17-fold, a claim not detailed in the available material.
threads.market_impact_zh: 传导路径是间接的：标准化椭圆曲线参数位于 TLS 以及加密交易所和钱包软件所依赖的大部分公钥基础设施之下，因此这一结果主要影响的是关于参数来源的长期信任争论，而非任何特定代币的供给或流动性。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission path is indirect: standardized elliptic-curve parameters sit under TLS and much of the public-key infrastructure that crypto exchanges and wallet software depend on, so the result mainly affects the long-running trust debate over parameter provenance rather than any specific token's supply or liquidity.

threads.title_zh: Cysic 加密跨链桥在 1000 万枚 CYS 被未经授权铸造后暂停
threads.title_en: Cysic crypto bridge halted after unauthorized mint of 10M CYS
threads.summary_zh: Cysic 跨链桥仍处于暂停状态，涉事地址已被链上黑名单限制，约 280 万枚 CYS 无法转出；项目称主网和用户钱包资产未受影响，并已聘请安全公司调查和追踪资金。
threads.summary_en: The Cysic cross-chain bridge remains paused, the involved address is blacklisted on-chain with about 2.8 million CYS frozen, and the project says the mainnet and user wallet assets were unaffected while a security firm investigates and traces funds.
threads.latest_update_zh: Cysic 补充称攻击发生于 10 月 17 日，黑客获取跨链服务相关数据库访问权限并提交虚假铸造消息；本次事件仅影响跨链桥消息处理与铸造功能，未影响 Cysic 主网或用户钱包现有资产，团队已聘请安全公司调查攻击路径并追踪资金。
threads.latest_update_en: Cysic added that the attack occurred on October 17 after the attacker gained access to a database related to the cross-chain service and submitted false mint messages; the incident was limited to the bridge's message-processing and minting functions, did not affect the Cysic mainnet or existing assets in user wallets, and the team hired a security firm to investigate the attack path and trace funds.
threads.background_zh: Cysic 自称是一个全栈算力网络（ComputeFi），根据其代币经济文档，CYS 代币用于协调用户、算力提供方、治理参与者与贡献者之间的激励。跨链桥长期以来是去中心化金融中最主要的攻击面之一，漏洞通常出现在消息验证、验证者信任机制，或运营密钥与数据库访问权限等环节。
threads.background_en: Cysic describes itself as a full-stack compute network (ComputeFi), and its CYS token, per the project's tokenomics documentation, coordinates incentives among users, compute providers, governance participants and contributors. Cross-chain bridges have repeatedly been a leading attack vector in decentralized finance, with flaws typically arising in message verification, validator trust or operational key and database access.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Cysic's cross-chain bridge was exploited on October 17, allowing an attacker to mint 10 million CYS without authorization on BNB Chain via a logic flaw and database access, prompting the team to pause the bridge and blacklist involved addresses.
threads.latest_summary_en: Cysic's cross-chain bridge was exploited on October 17, allowing an attacker to mint 10 million CYS without authorization on BNB Chain via a logic flaw and database access, prompting the team to pause the bridge and blacklist involved addresses.
threads.market_impact_zh: 风险敞口集中在 BNB Smart Chain 上的 CYS 流动性：跨链桥已暂停，切断了 CYS 在网络间流转的跨链通道；同时约 280 万枚未经授权铸造的代币滞留在被拉黑地址中无法转移。若该笔铸造中仍有未被拉黑的部分，则构成新增供应对代币形成潜在抛压，最终损失规模取决于基金会正在进行的资金追踪核查结果。
threads.market_impact_en: The exposure is concentrated in CYS liquidity on BNB Smart Chain: the bridge has been paused, cutting the cross-chain channel that moves CYS between networks, while roughly 2.8 million of the unauthorized tokens sit in a blacklisted address that cannot transfer them. Any remaining unblacklisted portion of the mint would represent newly created supply overhanging the token, and the eventual loss figure depends on the foundation's ongoing fund-tracing review.

threads.title_zh: Anthropic披露Claude Code团队以AI审查AI的大规模代码审查实践
threads.title_en: Anthropic details AI-reviewing-AI code review practice for Claude Code team
threads.summary_zh: Anthropic 披露，Claude Code 约 90% 的代码如今由 Claude 编写，并已围绕多智能体 AI 检查与按风险分级的人工审批重建代码审查流程，同时对失控的审查循环设限——此前有一次改动在一夜之间经历了 50 多轮审查。
threads.summary_en: Anthropic disclosed that roughly 90% of Claude Code's code is now written by Claude and that it has rebuilt code review around multi-agent AI checking with risk-tiered human approval, while capping runaway review loops after one change went through 50+ rounds in a single night.

threads.latest_update_en: Anthropic disclosed that roughly 90% of Claude Code's code is now written by Claude and that it has rebuilt code review around multi-agent AI checking with risk-tiered human approval, while capping runaway review loops after one change went through 50+ rounds in a single night.
threads.background_zh: 该博文出自 Anthropic 的 Claude Code 团队；Claude Code 是 Anthropic 的智能体式编程工具，最初以限定研究预览形式发布，并通过 npm 与 winget 分发。自动代码审查本身是一个成熟的工具类别，指在不经人工干预的情况下用软件分析源代码中的安全漏洞、缺陷与编码规范违规。
threads.background_en: The post comes from Anthropic's Claude Code team; Claude Code is Anthropic's agentic coding tool, launched in a limited research preview and distributed via npm and winget. Automated code review is itself an established tooling category that analyzes source code for security vulnerabilities, bugs and coding-standard violations without human intervention.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Anthropic disclosed that roughly 90% of Claude Code's code is now written by Claude and that it has rebuilt code review around multi-agent AI checking with risk-tiered human approval, while capping runaway review loops after one change went through 50+ rounds in a single night.
threads.latest_summary_en: Anthropic disclosed that roughly 90% of Claude Code's code is now written by Claude and that it has rebuilt code review around multi-agent AI checking with risk-tiered human approval, while capping runaway review loops after one change went through 50+ rounds in a single night.
threads.discussion_zh: 在 Hacker News 的讨论（189 分、179 条评论）中，整体氛围偏批评而非宣传：有人质疑如此规模下的代码流失率与每行代码成本，有人怀疑 AI 审查 AI 生成的代码、每天 3 万个 PR 时“审查”还能否名副其实，也有人认为文风过于精致、未必反映真实做法；还有评论者反对让大模型写文档却无人阅读。
threads.discussion_en: The Hacker News thread (189 points, 179 comments) was critical rather than promotional: commenters questioned the churn rate and cost per line of code at that volume, whether AI reviewing AI-generated code at 30k PRs a day can meaningfully be called review, and whether the polished prose reflects genuine practice; one objected to letting an LLM write docs that nobody reads.

timeline.text_zh:
Anthropic 的 Claude Code 团队发布博文，介绍其大规模代码审查流程：据其描述每天处理约 3 万个 PR，大部分路径已自动化，人的注意力被引导到高风险改动上。文档、文案、仅内部使用的功能以及带开关的增量改动等低风险改动，只要自动审查与安全检查通过，就不需要人工批准。

按照该团队自己的表述，这套流程的目的是把有限的人工审查精力只放到有风险的地方；同时评估套件（eval suite）会随每一次事故扩充，审查器的每一次改动都要针对整个套件评分。

每天约 3 万个 PR 的数字以及低风险类别（文档、文案、仅内部功能、带开关的增量改动）均出自该团队自己的博文，而非独立测算。
timeline.text_en:
Anthropic's Claude Code team published a post describing how it runs code review at scale, reporting roughly 30,000 pull requests per day, with most of the path automated and human attention directed to high-risk changes. Low-risk changes — docs, copy, internal-only features and additive changes behind a flag — require no human approval once automated review and security checks are green.

According to the team's own framing, the pipeline is designed to send scarce human review attention only where the risk is, while the reviewer's eval suite grows with every incident and every change to the reviewer is scored against all of it.

The ~30k PRs/day figure and the low-risk categories (docs, copy, internal-only features, additive changes behind a flag) come from the team's own blog post rather than independent measurement.

threads.summary_en: Ripple's prime brokerage arm Ripple Prime rolled out institutional RWA perpetual contracts spanning 100+ stock, index, ETF and commodity markets through Hyperliquid-based Trade.xyz, offering shared cross-position margin and weekend/after-hours exposure.
threads.latest_update_zh:
据彭博社10月15日报道，Ripple旗下主经纪商部门Ripple Prime正面向机构客户推出现实世界资产（RWA）永续合约，覆盖股票、指数、ETF、大宗商品等100多个参考市场。该产品通过Hyperliquid上的Trade.xyz提供，并支持跨仓位共享保证金，延续了Ripple Prime此前向客户开放加密永续合约交易的布局。

Ripple Prime国际首席执行官Michael Higgins表示，此举有助于机构提高资金使用和仓位管理效率。客户既可将永续合约与标的资产配对开展基差交易，也可利用合约进行方向性交易，在传统市场休市期间及周末获取相关资产敞口。

Higgins还表示，传统对冲基金已「非常接近」直接参与代币化RWA市场，关键在于建立符合其交易对手及反洗钱要求的基础设施。据报道，过去一年，数个主要交易平台的RWA永续合约未平仓规模已从接近零增至90亿美元。
threads.latest_update_en: Ripple's prime brokerage arm Ripple Prime rolled out institutional RWA perpetual contracts spanning 100+ stock, index, ETF and commodity markets through Hyperliquid-based Trade.xyz, offering shared cross-position margin and weekend/after-hours exposure.
threads.background_zh: RWA永续合约是一种在链上追踪现实世界资产价格的永续期货。本次产品所依托的Trade.xyz在Hyperliquid上提供股票、指数、原油和外汇等永续合约交易。
threads.background_en: RWA perpetual contracts are perpetual futures that track real-world asset prices on-chain. Trade.xyz, the venue used for this rollout, lists stock, index, oil and FX perpetuals on Hyperliquid.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Ripple's prime brokerage arm Ripple Prime rolled out institutional RWA perpetual contracts spanning 100+ stock, index, ETF and commodity markets through Hyperliquid-based Trade.xyz, offering shared cross-position margin and weekend/after-hours exposure.
threads.latest_summary_en: Ripple's prime brokerage arm Ripple Prime rolled out institutional RWA perpetual contracts spanning 100+ stock, index, ETF and commodity markets through Hyperliquid-based Trade.xyz, offering shared cross-position margin and weekend/after-hours exposure.
threads.market_impact_zh: 此次推出将机构订单流引向链上永续合约平台——Hyperliquid与Trade.xyz——而该RWA永续合约板块过去一年在各主要平台的未平仓规模已增至约90亿美元。跨仓位共享保证金使抵押资金池与股票、指数、ETF及大宗商品敞口的关联更为直接，也使Ripple Prime的主经纪业务与其他上线代币化传统资产衍生品的平台形成并列竞争。
threads.market_impact_en: The launch routes institutional order flow toward on-chain perpetual venues — Hyperliquid and Trade.xyz — within an RWA perpetual segment whose open interest across major venues has grown to roughly $9 billion over the past year. Cross-position shared margin ties collateral pools more directly to equity, index, ETF and commodity exposure, placing Ripple Prime's brokerage offering alongside other venues listing tokenized traditional-asset derivatives.

threads.title_zh: Meta发布Muse Spark Open开源权重模型
threads.title_en: Meta launches Muse Spark Open open-weight model
threads.summary_zh: Meta 新发布的开放权重模型 Muse Spark Open 在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数上得分 39，取代英伟达的 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 成为美国最强开放模型，但落后于小米 MiMo-V2.6-Pro（46）和智谱 GLM-5.3（45）等中国模型，其智能体测试表现明显偏弱，但以同类最佳的知识准确性和更低的 token 成本弥补。
threads.summary_en: Meta's newly released open-weights model Muse Spark Open scored 39 on the Artificial Analysis intelligence index, displacing Nvidia's Nemotron 3.5 Super VL as the top US open model but trailing Chinese models like Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro (46) and Zhipu GLM-5.3 (45), with notably weak agent-test performance offset by best-in-class knowledge accuracy and lower token costs.
threads.latest_update_zh: Meta 新发布的开放权重模型 Muse Spark Open 在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数上得分 39，取代英伟达的 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 成为美国最强开放模型，但落后于小米 MiMo-V2.6-Pro（46）和智谱 GLM-5.3（45）等中国模型，其智能体测试表现明显偏弱，但以同类最佳的知识准确性和更低的 token 成本弥补。
threads.latest_update_en: Meta's newly released open-weights model Muse Spark Open scored 39 on the Artificial Analysis intelligence index, displacing Nvidia's Nemotron 3.5 Super VL as the top US open model but trailing Chinese models like Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro (46) and Zhipu GLM-5.3 (45), with notably weak agent-test performance offset by best-in-class knowledge accuracy and lower token costs.
threads.background_zh: 开放权重模型会公开训练好的参数，任何人都可以下载并用自己的硬件运行，而不必只通过开发者的在线服务使用，Meta 的 Llama 系列是其中最知名的例子之一。MLX 是 Apple 为 Apple 芯片上的机器学习开发的开源数组框架，于 2023 年 12 月首次发布；Meta 此前发布模型系列时也曾搭配指定运行时。
threads.background_en: Open-weight models publish their trained parameters so anyone can download and run them on their own hardware rather than only through the developer's online service, with Meta's Llama family among the best-known examples. MLX is Apple's open-source array framework for machine learning on Apple silicon, first released in December 2023; Meta's previous model-family releases have also paired weights with named runtimes.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Meta's newly released open-weights model Muse Spark Open scored 39 on the Artificial Analysis intelligence index, displacing Nvidia's Nemotron 3.5 Super VL as the top US open model but trailing Chinese models like Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro (46) and Zhipu GLM-5.3 (45), with notably weak agent-test performance offset by best-in-class knowledge accuracy and lower token costs.
threads.latest_summary_en: Meta's newly released open-weights model Muse Spark Open scored 39 on the Artificial Analysis intelligence index, displacing Nvidia's Nemotron 3.5 Super VL as the top US open model but trailing Chinese models like Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro (46) and Zhipu GLM-5.3 (45), with notably weak agent-test performance offset by best-in-class knowledge accuracy and lower token costs.
threads.discussion_zh: 评论者意见不一。有人引用 Artificial Analysis 的结果指出，该模型表现不及 Qwen3.8 Flash Next 和 GLM 5.3 Flash，而后两者都能在单台 B300 上运行，并认为 Meta 在开放权重领域还需要追赶；也有人质疑“开放权重”这一说法，指出许可证中存在限制条款：当第三方及关联方总营收超过 2000 万美元时，不得以 API 等形式把该模型作为服务对外提供。多位评论者称赞其运行器支持范围广（Unsloth、MLX），还有人认为 Meta 的真正策略是打造黏性生态，而非以“前沿智能”收取租金。
threads.discussion_en: Commenters were divided. One cited Artificial Analysis results showing the model underperforming Qwen3.8 Flash Next and GLM 5.3 Flash, both of which can run on a single B300, and said Meta has catching up to do in the open-weight space; others disputed the "open weight" label, pointing to a license clause restricting third parties with aggregate gross revenue above $20 million from offering the model as a service. Several praised the breadth of runner support (Unsloth, MLX), and one argued Meta's real strategy is building a sticky ecosystem rather than charging rent for frontier intelligence.
threads.market_impact_zh: 最清晰的传导渠道是推理经济学：可免费下载的前沿级权重会扩大自建部署和本地推理，从而影响对托管 API 容量与算力硬件的需求，并影响 AI 与去中心化算力相关加密板块的市场情绪。此次发布本身没有直接的代币或协议关联，因此对加密市场的影响属于间接的叙事层面。
threads.market_impact_en: The clearest transmission channel is inference economics: freely downloadable frontier-class weights expand self-hosting and local inference, which bears on demand for hosted API capacity and compute hardware, and feeds sentiment in AI- and decentralized-compute-related crypto segments. The release itself has no direct token or protocol linkage, so any crypto-market effect would be indirect and narrative-driven.

timeline.text_zh: 新增细节：模型支持 100 万 Token 上下文；四台 M5 Ultra Mac Studio 协同运行在 8192 Token 上下文下约 37 tokens/秒；采用自定义 Muse Model License，允许修改、商用和分发但需注明来源，企业连续12个月营收超过2000万美元若将模型作为 API 服务对外提供需与 Meta 另行签约；4 位精度下仍需约 493GB 内存，最低部署需两台配备 512GB 统一内存的 M5 Ultra Mac Studio，硬件成本超过 4 万美元。
timeline.text_en: Added details: 1M-token context; ~37 tokens/sec on four M5 Ultra Mac Studios at 8192-token context; custom Muse Model License permits modification, commercial use, and distribution with attribution, but enterprises with >$20M trailing 12-month revenue need a separate Meta agreement to offer the model as an API service; requires ~493GB memory at 4-bit, minimum two M5 Ultra Mac Studios with 512GB unified memory each, hardware cost over $40k.

timeline.text_zh:
Meta 发布了 Muse Spark Open，这是一个开放权重的前沿多模态混合专家模型，Meta 称其为“迄今为止美国最强的开放权重模型”。Meta 表示，这是同类模型中首个可在桌面端运行的产品，需使用两台 Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studio 和最新的 MLX 框架；Hugging Face 上的模型页面将其列为 Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B。

由于权重公开发布，前沿级多模态参数可以被下载、微调和自行部署，而不再只能通过 Meta 的服务访问。Meta 同时把 Apple 芯片定位为目标部署平台，主张这一级别的模型已可在本地桌面端运行。

Meta 与 Apple 为此次发布进行了合作，模型针对在 Apple 芯片上本地运行做了优化；社区引用的 Meta 部署文档显示其支持多种模型运行器，包括 Unsloth 和 MLX。已公布的模型标识为 Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B。
timeline.text_en: Meta launched Muse Spark Open, an 816B-parameter (42B active) open-weights model published on Hugging Face with broad inference-runner and Mac Studio support, prompting community debate over its competitive benchmarks versus Qwen and GLM models and its revenue-capped 'Model as a Service' license clause.

threads.title_zh: Reflection 推出 Beam：一款以更低算力成本对标中国模型的开源权重 AI 模型
threads.title_en: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost
threads.summary_zh: Beam 1.0 的完整权重已于 2026 年 10 月 16 日前后在 Hugging Face 上以 Apache 2.0 协议发布，提供 BF16、FP8 和 NVFP4 版本，支持 100 万 token 上下文。Reflection 同时开源了 Mirror CLI 编程智能体框架和 DFlash2 推测解码加速模型，并与 vLLM 合作优化推理性能。Artificial Analysis 独立评测给 Beam 打 30 分，在美国开放权重模型中排名第二，但落后于 DeepSeek、GLM 等中国模型。发布获 40 多家合作伙伴支持。英伟达进一步注资或收购 Reflection 的谈判仍在进行中。
threads.summary_en: Beam 1.0's full weights were released on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0 around October 16, 2026, with BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 versions and 1M-token context. Reflection also open-sourced the Mirror CLI coding agent framework and DFlash2 speculative decoding accelerator, and worked with vLLM to optimize inference. Independent Artificial Analysis evaluation gives Beam a score of 30, ranking second among US open-weight models but behind Chinese models such as DeepSeek and GLM. The release has support from over 40 partners. Nvidia's reported talks to further invest in or acquire Reflection are ongoing.
threads.latest_update_zh: Reflection 已将 Beam 1.0 的权重上传至 Hugging Face，兑现 10 月 5 日预告，采用 Apache 2.0 许可，同时开放 BF16、FP8、NVFP4 版本，支持 100 万 token 上下文。此外还开源了 Mirror CLI 编程智能体框架和 DFlash2 推测解码加速模型，并与 vLLM 团队合作优化推理，单请求解码每步耗时从 8.95ms 降至 3.30ms（2.71 倍提速）。Artificial Analysis 独立评测给 Beam 30 分，在美国开放权重模型中排名第二，但落后于中国模型。发布获 AWS、Google Cloud、英伟达等 40 多家合作伙伴支持。此前报道的英伟达进一步注资或收购 Reflection 的谈判仍在进行中。
threads.latest_update_en: Reflection has uploaded the weights of Beam 1.0 to Hugging Face, fulfilling its October 5 preview, under Apache 2.0 with BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 versions and 1M-token context. It also open-sourced the Mirror CLI coding agent framework and DFlash2 speculative decoding accelerator, and worked with vLLM to optimize inference, cutting per-step decoding time for a single request from 8.95 ms to 3.30 ms (2.71x speedup). Artificial Analysis gives Beam a score of 30, ranking second among US open-weight models but behind Chinese models. The release has support from over 40 partners including AWS, Google Cloud and Nvidia. Nvidia's reported talks to further invest in or acquire Reflection are ongoing.
threads.background_zh: 开源权重指已训练 AI 模型公开释放的学习参数，是否允许修改、微调或再分发取决于具体许可证。DeepSeek、阿里云、月之暗面（Moonshot AI）和 Z.ai 等中国企业普遍以 Apache 或 MIT 等宽松许可发布开源权重模型，而美国大型实验室更倾向于闭源发布。截至 2026 年 7 月，规模最大的开源权重前沿模型是月之暗面的 Kimi K3（2.8 万亿参数）和阿里云的 Qwen3.8（2.4 万亿参数）。
threads.background_en: Open weights are the publicly released learned parameters of a trained AI model; permission to modify, fine-tune or redistribute them depends on the license. Chinese companies including DeepSeek, Alibaba Cloud, Moonshot AI and Z.ai have generally released open-weight models under permissive licenses such as Apache or MIT, while large US labs have favored proprietary releases. As of July 2026, the largest open-weight frontier models were Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 at 2.8 trillion parameters and Alibaba Cloud's Qwen3.8 at 2.4 trillion.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Reflection released the open weights of its first model Beam 1.0 — a 501B-parameter MoE with ~23B active parameters and 1M-token context under Apache 2.0 — alongside the Mirror CLI agent framework, the DFlash2 speculative decoding accelerator, and vLLM inference optimizations that cut per-step decoding time by 2.71x.
threads.latest_summary_en: Reflection released the open weights of its first model Beam 1.0 — a 501B-parameter MoE with ~23B active parameters and 1M-token context under Apache 2.0 — alongside the Mirror CLI agent framework, the DFlash2 speculative decoding accelerator, and vLLM inference optimizations that cut per-step decoding time by 2.71x.
threads.market_impact_zh: 开源权重模型的发布会把部分模型部署转向自托管和本地司法辖区内的“AI 工厂”模式，这一渠道影响的是 GPU 与基础设施需求、推理托管和 API 定价，而非直接作用于交易市场。Reflection 获得英伟达投资，并以主权国家与企业为销售对象，因此与基础设施和算力需求这一议题相关联。
threads.market_impact_en: Open-weight releases shift part of model deployment toward self-hosting and in-jurisdiction "AI factory" setups, a channel that touches GPU and infrastructure demand, inference hosting and API pricing rather than trading directly. Reflection's Nvidia backing and its sovereign-enterprise go-to-market place it in that infrastructure and compute-demand discussion.

reference_links.title: Introducing Beam: Reflection’s 501B open-weight model
Nvidia-backed Reflection unveils first AI model to take on ...

timeline.text_zh: Reflection 已将 Beam 1.0 的权重上传至 Hugging Face，兑现 10 月 5 日预告，采用 Apache 2.0 许可，同时开放 BF16、FP8、NVFP4 版本，支持 100 万 token 上下文。此外还开源了 Mirror CLI 编程智能体框架和 DFlash2 推测解码加速模型，并与 vLLM 团队合作优化推理，单请求解码每步耗时从 8.95ms 降至 3.30ms（2.71 倍提速）。Artificial Analysis 独立评测给 Beam 30 分，在美国开放权重模型中排名第二，但落后于中国模型。发布获 AWS、Google Cloud、英伟达等 40 多家合作伙伴支持。此前报道的英伟达进一步注资或收购 Reflection 的谈判仍在进行中。
timeline.text_en: Reflection has uploaded the weights of Beam 1.0 to Hugging Face, fulfilling its October 5 preview, under Apache 2.0 with BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 versions and 1M-token context. It also open-sourced the Mirror CLI coding agent framework and DFlash2 speculative decoding accelerator, and worked with vLLM to optimize inference, cutting per-step decoding time for a single request from 8.95 ms to 3.30 ms (2.71x speedup). Artificial Analysis gives Beam a score of 30, ranking second among US open-weight models but behind Chinese models. The release has support from over 40 partners including AWS, Google Cloud and Nvidia. Nvidia's reported talks to further invest in or acquire Reflection are ongoing.

timeline.text_zh: 新报道补充了 Reflection 自行公布的基准测试结果，显示 Beam 在 DeepSWE 上得分 44.4，接近 GLM-5.2（44.0），但落后于 Qwen 3.8-Max、GLM-5.3、Kimi K3 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash。训练方面，预训练使用 6144 块 GB300，不到 4 周处理 23.8 万亿 token；随后用 1.05 万块 GB300 进行 4 周强化学习，生成超过 1 亿条训练轨迹。Beam 仍在最后安全测试阶段，仅少量用户可提前使用；完整权重、技术报告和模型卡计划本月晚些时候以 Apache 2.0 协议发布。
timeline.text_en: New coverage adds Reflection's own benchmark results showing Beam scoring 44.4 on DeepSWE, close to GLM-5.2's 44.0 but behind Qwen 3.8-Max, GLM-5.3, Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Training details: pretraining on 6,144 GB300 GPUs processing 23.8 trillion tokens in under 4 weeks, followed by 4 weeks of reinforcement learning on 10,500 GB300 GPUs generating over 100 million rollouts. Beam is still in final safety testing with limited early access; full weights, technical report and model card are planned for later this month under Apache 2.0.

timeline.text_zh:
2026 年 10 月 5 日（周一），Reflection AI 发布了其首个前沿开源权重模型 Beam。据该公司博客介绍，Beam 是一个稀疏混合专家（MoE）模型，总参数 5010 亿、激活参数 230 亿，面向编程、推理与智能体（agentic）任务。

此次发布使一家美国实验室在编程及相关任务上，直接与 DeepSeek、月之暗面 Kimi 等低成本中国开源权重模型展开竞争，而这一领域此前由中国模型的成本水平树立标杆。

Reflection 由英伟达（Nvidia）投资，并以“AI 工厂”（AI factories）产品向企业和主权国家推销 Beam 及后续模型，允许机构用自有专有数据训练这些模型。目前公开报道中未包含独立的基准测试结果或授权条款。
timeline.text_en:
Reflection AI unveiled Beam on Monday, October 5, 2026, its first frontier open-weight model. According to the company's blog, Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 501 billion total parameters and 23 billion active, built for coding, reasoning and agentic workloads.

The launch puts a US lab in direct competition with lower-cost Chinese open-weight models such as DeepSeek and Moonshot AI's Kimi in coding and related tasks, a segment where Chinese releases have set the cost benchmark.

Reflection is Nvidia-backed and is pitching Beam and future models at enterprises and sovereign nations through an "AI factories" offering that would let institutions train the models on their own proprietary data. The available coverage does not include independent benchmark results or licensing terms.

Binance has previously enabled spot algo bot services for bStocks pairs at launch.

threads.market_impact_zh: 这批交易对扩大了币安现货市场对代币化美国股票的敞口，新增以 USDT 报价的品种及机器人驱动的成交，与既有现货市场争夺同一订单簿流动性。零挂单手续费窗口与一小时内免费兑换为 BTC/USDT，可能在短期内使订单流在新 bStocks 交易对与币安主要加密交易对之间转移，但辖区分级限制决定了哪些用户可以使用这些产品。
threads.market_impact_en: The pairs broaden Binance spot exposure to tokenized US equities, adding new USDT-quoted instruments and bot-driven flow that compete for the same order-book liquidity as existing spot markets. The zero-maker-fee window and one-hour free conversion into BTC/USDT can shift short-term order flow between the new bStocks pairs and major crypto pairs on Binance, though jurisdictional restrictions limit who can access the products.

threads.title_en: Liquidations jump to $547 million as oil rally hits crypto market
threads.summary_zh: 在 CPI 和 PPI 数据高于预期后，比特币跌破 80,000 美元，24 小时内引发近 9.48 亿美元的加密清算，使美国现货 ETF 持有者在其约 82,300 美元的平均成本基础附近陷入亏损。
threads.summary_en: Bitcoin slid below $80,000 after hotter-than-expected CPI and PPI data, driving nearly $948 million in crypto liquidations over 24 hours and leaving U.S. spot ETF holders underwater near their ~$82,300 average cost basis.

threads.latest_update_en: Bitcoin slid below $80,000 after hotter-than-expected CPI and PPI data, driving nearly $948 million in crypto liquidations over 24 hours and leaving U.S. spot ETF holders underwater near their ~$82,300 average cost basis.
threads.background_zh: 清算是指当亏损使抵押品跌破交易所维持保证金要求时，杠杆仓位被强制自动平仓，由此产生的抛售会进一步压低价格并触发更多清算。此次的导火索是通胀数据：9月消费者价格同比上涨3.7%，高于3.6%的预期，核心通胀为2.6%，高于2.5%；周四公布的生产者价格指数同比上涨6.3%，高于5.5%的预期。Kalchev认为这更像是对风险资产的普遍撤离而非单纯的联储叙事，并列举了股市与铜价下跌、黄金上涨以及韩国Kospi指数下跌约8%。
threads.background_en: A liquidation is the forced, automatic closure of a leveraged position once losses push collateral below the exchange's maintenance margin, and the resulting forced selling can drag prices lower and trigger further liquidations. The trigger this time was inflation data: September consumer prices rose 3.7% year over year against a 3.6% forecast, with core inflation at 2.6% versus 2.5%, while Thursday's Producer Price Index rose 6.3% annually versus 5.5% expected. Kalchev framed the selloff as a broad exit from risk assets rather than purely a Fed story, citing falling stocks and copper, rising gold and a roughly 8% drop in South Korea's Kospi.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Bitcoin slid below $80,000 after hotter-than-expected CPI and PPI data, driving nearly $948 million in crypto liquidations over 24 hours and leaving U.S. spot ETF holders underwater near their ~$82,300 average cost basis.
threads.latest_summary_en: Bitcoin slid below $80,000 after hotter-than-expected CPI and PPI data, driving nearly $948 million in crypto liquidations over 24 hours and leaving U.S. spot ETF holders underwater near their ~$82,300 average cost basis.
threads.market_impact_zh: 传导主要通过杠杆与利率渠道：CPI/PPI数据超预期推高美债收益率与美元，抬高了杠杆加密仓位所依赖的廉价资金成本，其表现就是集中在比特币与以太坊永续合约上的多头强制平仓连锁反应。与此同时，持续跌破约82,300美元的现货ETF平均成本价，是ETF持有者仓位可能发生变化的通道；Kalchev认为，ETF资金流向因此成为需要关注的关键变量。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission runs mainly through leverage and rates: a hot CPI/PPI print lifts Treasury yields and the dollar, raising the cost of the cheap money that leveraged crypto positions depend on, which shows up as a cascade of forced long liquidations concentrated in Bitcoin and Ethereum perpetuals. A sustained move below the ~$82,300 average spot ETF cost basis is also the channel through which ETF-holder positioning could shift, making ETF flows the level to watch, according to Kalchev.

threads.title_en: Binance to Discontinue Binance Pool and Related Services on November 10, 2026
threads.summary_zh: 币安矿池仍计划于2026年11月10日关闭，但矿池算力已大幅下降，矿工正迁往其他矿池，关闭带来的算力再分配和矿池竞争影响正在显现。
threads.summary_en: Binance Pool remains scheduled to close on November 10, 2026, but its hashrate has dropped substantially, miners are migrating to alternative pools, and the closure's impact on hash rate redistribution and pool competition is becoming apparent.
threads.latest_update_zh: 币安矿池算力已下跌约65%，矿工迁移至其他矿池，且2022年10月推出的5亿美元借贷计划在关闭通知中未提及；EMCD和OCEAN等替代矿池正积极争取迁出矿工。
threads.latest_update_en: Binance Pool's hashrate has fallen roughly 65%, miners are migrating to alternative pools, the $500 million lending program launched in October 2022 was not addressed in the closure notice, and alternative pools including EMCD and OCEAN are actively courting displaced miners.
threads.background_zh: 币安矿池曾将自身定位为旨在提升矿工收益的综合服务平台，其算力规模在比特币矿池中位居前列。MiningPoolStats、Blockchain.com 与 HashrateIndex 等服务会追踪比特币矿池的市场份额，供矿工比较算力、费率与结算方式。
threads.background_en: Binance Pool marketed itself as a comprehensive service platform intended to improve miners' income, and ranked among the larger Bitcoin mining pools by hash rate. Bitcoin mining pool market share is tracked by services such as MiningPoolStats, Blockchain.com and HashrateIndex, which let miners compare hashrate, fees and payout methods.
threads.latest_summary_zh:
币安矿池（Binance Pool）正在逐步关停其比特币矿池业务，相关报道指出关闭日期为11月10日，此前该矿池算力已下跌约65%。其矿工群体需要将矿机、收益结算设置与账户迁移至其他矿池。

此次关闭将迫使比特币算力在剩余矿池之间重新分配，这一变化直接影响挖矿集中度，并随着迁移矿工选择新运营方而影响各矿池的经济格局。

据 Mempool Brief 报道，关闭通知并未提及币安于2022年10月通过该矿池推出的5亿美元借贷计划。包括 EMCD 和 OCEAN 在内的替代矿池正在积极争取从币安矿池迁出的矿工。
threads.latest_summary_en:
Binance Pool is winding down its Bitcoin mining pool operation, with reports pointing to a shutdown on Nov. 10 after the pool's hashrate fell roughly 65%. Its miner base must now migrate hardware, payout settings and accounts to alternative pools.

The closure forces a redistribution of hash rate among the remaining Bitcoin mining pools, a shift that bears directly on mining concentration and on pool economics as displaced miners choose new operators.

The closure notice does not address the $500 million lending program Binance announced through the pool in October 2022, according to Mempool Brief. Alternative pools, including EMCD and OCEAN, are actively courting displaced Binance Pool miners.
threads.market_impact_zh: 其传导渠道在于挖矿基础设施而非现货价格：流失的算力将流向 Foundry USA、AntPool、F2Pool、ViaBTC 等矿池，可能在矿工调整收益地址与账户安排的同时，提高少数矿池运营方的集中度。币安的挖矿相关服务以及与该矿池相关的借贷敞口是受影响最直接的板块。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through mining infrastructure rather than spot prices: displaced hash rate moves to pools such as Foundry USA, AntPool, F2Pool and ViaBTC, potentially increasing concentration among fewer pool operators while miners adjust payout addresses and account arrangements. Binance's mining-related services and its lending exposure tied to the pool are the segments most directly affected.

threads.title_zh: 【WSJ：Bo Hines 任职白宫期间，其持股公司通过 Tether 相关合作获 630 万美元】
threads.title_en: 【WSJ：Bo Hines 任职白宫期间，其持股公司通过 Tether 相关合作获 630 万美元】
threads.summary_zh: WSJ/Protos 报道称 Tether 在 Bo Hines 任职白宫数字资产顾问期间通过 Bitfinex 和中介 Notorious 向 Hines 联合创立的 Nxum Capital 支付 630 万美元，首笔 249 万美元于 2025-05-11 转出；Hines 离开白宫后合同直接转给 Nxum；Nxum 否认 Hines 在白宫期间收到 Tether 相关资金；报道还提及相关超级 PAC 资金与 GENIUS Act 推进。
threads.summary_en: WSJ/Protos reported that Tether paid $6.3M to Nxum Capital, co-founded by Bo Hines, while Hines was a White House digital-assets adviser, with funds routed via Bitfinex and intermediary Notorious; the first $2.49M payment was sent on May 11, 2025; the contract was transferred directly to Nxum after Hines left the White House; Nxum denies Hines received Tether-derived funds during that period; the report also mentions related super PAC funding and GENIUS Act advocacy.
threads.latest_update_zh: WSJ/Protos 补充细节：Tether 通过 Bitfinex 与中介 Notorious 向 Nxum 支付，首笔 249 万美元于 2025-05-11 转出；Hines 离开白宫后合同直接转给 Nxum；Nxum 否认 Hines 在白宫期间收到 Tether 相关资金；报道还提及相关超级 PAC 资金。
threads.latest_update_en: WSJ/Protos added details: Tether routed payments to Nxum via Bitfinex and intermediary Notorious, with the first $2.49M sent on May 11, 2025; the contract was transferred directly to Nxum after Hines left the White House; Nxum denied Hines received Tether-derived funds during his White House tenure; the report also mentioned related super PAC funding.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The Wall Street Journal reported that Tether paid $6.3 million to Nxum Capital — the firm of Bo Hines — while Hines was serving as the White House's top digital-assets adviser and helping advance stablecoin legislation, with funds routed via Bitfinex and intermediary firm Notorious.
threads.latest_summary_en: The Wall Street Journal reported that Tether paid $6.3 million to Nxum Capital — the firm of Bo Hines — while Hines was serving as the White House's top digital-assets adviser and helping advance stablecoin legislation, with funds routed via Bitfinex and intermediary firm Notorious.

timeline.text_zh: WSJ/Protos 补充细节：Tether 通过 Bitfinex 与中介 Notorious 向 Nxum 支付，首笔 249 万美元于 2025-05-11 转出；Hines 离开白宫后合同直接转给 Nxum；Nxum 否认 Hines 在白宫期间收到 Tether 相关资金；报道还提及相关超级 PAC 资金。
timeline.text_en: WSJ/Protos added details: Tether routed payments to Nxum via Bitfinex and intermediary Notorious, with the first $2.49M sent on May 11, 2025; the contract was transferred directly to Nxum after Hines left the White House; Nxum denied Hines received Tether-derived funds during his White House tenure; the report also mentioned related super PAC funding.

timeline.text_zh: 《华尔街日报》报道称，Bo Hines持有咨询公司Nxum的股份，该公司在他担任白宫加密货币委员会执行主任、推动《GENIUS法案》期间，从与Tether相关的合作中收取了630万美元，其中包括试图将该法案的合规过渡期从18个月延长至36个月，之后他才成为Tether美国业务负责人。
timeline.text_en: The Wall Street Journal reported that Bo Hines held a stake in consulting firm Nxum, which collected $6.3M from Tether-related partnerships while he was executive director of the White House crypto council pushing the GENIUS Act, including a bid to extend its compliance transition from 18 to 36 months, before he became head of Tether's US operations.

threads.title_zh: 布鲁克林检方捣毁针对俄语使用者的加密骗局背后112台服务器
threads.title_en: Brooklyn Prosecutors Take Down 112 Servers Behind Crypto Scam Targeting Russian Speakers
threads.summary_zh: 布鲁克林检察官和FBI查封或干扰了与一个针对俄语裔美国人的加密投资诈骗相关的112台服务器和241个网站；该骗局据称窃取数千万美元，目前已查获约30万美元，未宣布逮捕，调查人员称行动针对后端服务器以阻止替换网站出现。
threads.summary_en: Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI have seized or disrupted 112 servers and 241 websites tied to a Russian-language crypto investment scam that allegedly stole tens of millions from Russian-speaking U.S. victims; about $300,000 has been seized, no arrests were announced, and investigators targeted backend servers to prevent replacement sites.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新增细节：该行动于上周执行，源自三年调查，基础设施涉及乌克兰及其他东欧国家；未宣布逮捕；诈骗者还以虚假资金追回服务二次接触受害者；布鲁克林地区检察官虚拟货币部门此前已查封或干扰约400个相关域名。
threads.latest_update_en: New details: the operation was carried out last week after a three-year investigation, involved infrastructure in Ukraine and other Eastern European countries, no arrests were announced, scammers re-contacted victims with fake recovery offers, and the DA's Virtual Currency Unit had previously seized or disrupted about 400 related domains.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI seized or disrupted 241 scam websites and 112 servers tied to a Russian-language crypto investment fraud that allegedly stole tens of millions from Russian-speaking victims in the U.S., with victims then targeted by fake recovery offers.
threads.latest_summary_en: Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI seized or disrupted 241 scam websites and 112 servers tied to a Russian-language crypto investment fraud that allegedly stole tens of millions from Russian-speaking victims in the U.S., with victims then targeted by fake recovery offers.

timeline.text_zh: 新增细节：该行动于上周执行，源自三年调查，基础设施涉及乌克兰及其他东欧国家；未宣布逮捕；诈骗者还以虚假资金追回服务二次接触受害者；布鲁克林地区检察官虚拟货币部门此前已查封或干扰约400个相关域名。
timeline.text_en: New details: the operation was carried out last week after a three-year investigation, involved infrastructure in Ukraine and other Eastern European countries, no arrests were announced, scammers re-contacted victims with fake recovery offers, and the DA's Virtual Currency Unit had previously seized or disrupted about 400 related domains.

timeline.text_zh: 布鲁克林检方和FBI捣毁了一个跨国加密投资骗局相关的112台服务器和241个网站域名，该骗局针对讲俄语的美国人，窃取数千万美元，目前已查获约30万美元被盗资金。
timeline.text_en: Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI disrupted 112 servers and 241 web domains tied to a multinational crypto investment scam that targeted Russian-speaking Americans and stole tens of millions of dollars, seizing about $300,000 in stolen funds so far.

threads.title_zh: ⚡️美国9月PPI年率录得6.3%，高于市场预期
threads.title_en: ⚡️美国9月PPI年率录得6.3%，高于市场预期
threads.summary_zh: 美国9月PPI数据全面超预期：整体PPI环比1.3%、同比6.3%，核心PPI环比0.7%、同比5.0%，能源成本传导及顽固通胀压力强化美联储加息预期。
threads.summary_en: US September PPI data exceeded expectations across the board: headline PPI +1.3% MoM and +6.3% YoY, core PPI +0.7% MoM and +5.0% YoY, with energy cost pass-through and persistent inflation reinforcing Fed tightening expectations.
threads.latest_update_zh: 核心PPI环比上涨0.7%，同比上涨5.0%，能源成本上涨的影响传导至经济各领域，未来六个月投入价格预期指标升至2022年以来最高，强化了美联储继续加息的预期。
threads.latest_update_en: Core PPI rose 0.7% MoM and 5.0% YoY, with energy costs feeding through the economy; the six-month input price expectations gauge rose to its highest since 2022, reinforcing expectations of further Fed tightening.
threads.latest_summary_zh: US September producer prices rose far more than expected — headline PPI up 1.3% month-over-month and 6.3% year-over-year, core up 0.7% and 5.0% — as energy costs fed through the economy, reinforcing expectations that the Fed will keep tightening.
threads.latest_summary_en: US September producer prices rose far more than expected — headline PPI up 1.3% month-over-month and 6.3% year-over-year, core up 0.7% and 5.0% — as energy costs fed through the economy, reinforcing expectations that the Fed will keep tightening.

timeline.text_zh: 核心PPI环比上涨0.7%，同比上涨5.0%，能源成本上涨的影响传导至经济各领域，未来六个月投入价格预期指标升至2022年以来最高，强化了美联储继续加息的预期。
timeline.text_en: Core PPI rose 0.7% MoM and 5.0% YoY, with energy costs feeding through the economy; the six-month input price expectations gauge rose to its highest since 2022, reinforcing expectations of further Fed tightening.

timeline.text_zh: 美国9月PPI同比上涨6.3%，环比上涨1.3%，均远高于市场预期，并创下2026年5月以来最高年度读数，零售销售也超出预期。
timeline.text_en: US September PPI rose 6.3% year-over-year and 1.3% month-over-month, both well above market expectations and the highest annual reading since May 2026, with retail sales also beating forecasts.

focus.title_zh: OKX与ICE合资公司向SEC提交文件，规划代币化股票交易
focus.title_en: OKX-ICE Joint Venture Files with SEC for Tokenized Stock Trading
focus.summary_zh: OKXICE是OKX与ICE合资推进的代币化股票交易场所，已向SEC提交文件，并成为SEC披露的三家拟按创新豁免机制运营代币化证券交易场所的通知机构之一，计划使用X Layer网络；SEC强调列入名单不代表已满足豁免条件。该场所拟支持62家公司/63个股票代码的7×24小时代币化股票交易，通过AMM与流动性池撮合，并允许发行方提出异议。目前16家发行方已提出反对，纳斯达克也选择排除自身股票；OKX-ICE联席主席Andrew Cuomo称这一反对是正常且符合预期的反应。该场所尚未宣布上线日期，也并非SEC注册交易所。
focus.summary_en: OKXICE, the OKX-ICE joint venture tokenized stock venue, has filed with the SEC and is one of three firms the SEC disclosed as having notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its innovation exemption, planning to use the X Layer network; the SEC stressed that being listed does not confirm eligibility. The venue plans to support 24/7 trading of 62 companies/63 tickers via AMMs and liquidity pools, with issuers allowed to object. Sixteen issuers have objected, and Nasdaq is opting its own shares out; OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo called the opposition normal and expected. No launch date has been announced and the venue is not an SEC-registered exchange.
focus.latest_update_zh: SEC公开披露已有三家公司通知其计划按新创新豁免机制运营代币化证券交易场所，OKXICE为其中之一，并计划使用OKX旗下X Layer网络；SEC同时强调，列入名单不代表相关公司已满足豁免条件。
focus.latest_update_en: The SEC publicly disclosed that three firms have notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its new innovation exemption, including OKXICE, which plans to use OKX's X Layer network; the SEC cautioned that being listed does not confirm eligibility for the exemption.
focus.background_zh: 2026年1月28日，SEC公司金融部、投资管理部以及交易与市场部的工作人员发布联合声明，说明联邦证券法如何适用于代币化证券，包括通过分布式账本技术记录的发行人发起的代币化证券。OKX成立于2013年，原名Okcoin，2017年更名，按日交易量计算运营着规模最大的加密货币交易所之一。
focus.background_en: On January 28, 2026, staff of the SEC's Divisions of Corporation Finance, Investment Management, and Trading and Markets issued a joint statement on how federal securities laws apply to tokenized securities, including issuer-sponsored tokenized securities recorded via distributed ledger technology. OKX, founded in 2013 as Okcoin and rebranded in 2017, operates one of the largest cryptocurrency exchanges by daily trading volume.
focus.latest_summary_zh: The SEC disclosed that three firms — TSV LLC on Canton Network, the OKX–ICE joint venture OKXICE on X Layer, and Kephas Corp. on Kronos X — have notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its new innovation exemption, while cautioning that listing does not confirm eligibility.
focus.latest_summary_en: The SEC disclosed that three firms — TSV LLC on Canton Network, the OKX–ICE joint venture OKXICE on X Layer, and Kephas Corp. on Kronos X — have notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its new innovation exemption, while cautioning that listing does not confirm eligibility.
focus.market_impact_zh: 若该计划推进，股票敞口将通过加密交易场所撮合，使代币化股票产品、交易所交易量与托管安排与美国证券法对代币化股票的定性直接挂钩；SEC的这份文件正是这一传导路径的关键关口。
focus.market_impact_en: The plan, if it proceeds, would route equity exposure through a crypto trading venue, linking tokenized-equity products, exchange trading volumes and custody arrangements to how US securities law treats tokenized shares; the SEC filing is the gate through which that transmission runs.

timeline.text_en: The SEC publicly disclosed that three firms have notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its new innovation exemption, including OKXICE, which plans to use OKX's X Layer network; the SEC cautioned that being listed does not confirm eligibility for the exemption.

timeline.text_zh: OKX-ICE联席主席Andrew Cuomo公开回应发行方反对，称16家企业反对其股票被代币化交易是“正常反应”且符合预期，并重申该模式允许企业自主选择加入或退出。
timeline.text_en: OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo publicly responded to issuer opposition, calling the objections from 16 companies to their shares being tokenized a “normal reaction” and expected, while reiterating that the model lets issuers opt in or out.

timeline.text_zh: 微软、Alphabet、高盛、高通、卡特彼勒、麦当劳和西部数据这7家企业新提出反对，使已披露的反对发行方总数从9家增至16家（其中15家属于原62家公司名单，Cerebras不在最初名单内），OKXICE于10月19日更新了公开声明。
timeline.text_en: Seven more issuers — Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs, Qualcomm, Caterpillar, McDonald's and Western Digital — have objected, raising total disclosed objecting issuers from nine to 16 (15 of them on the original 62-company roster, with Cerebras outside that list), per the joint venture's 19 October updated public statement.

focus.title_zh: PHP披露两个严重远程代码执行漏洞并发布紧急补丁
focus.title_en: PHP discloses two critical RCE vulnerabilities and releases emergency patches
focus.summary_zh: PHP 基金会已发布紧急补丁；Cloudflare 报告称针对两个关键 PHP 漏洞的利用尝试达数百万次，其中数千次发生在公开披露之前；亚马逊进一步报告其 MadPot 蜜罐在公开披露前约四天已观测到利用尝试，但尚不清楚禁运期内利用信息如何泄露，也未证实真实系统被攻破。
focus.summary_en: The PHP Foundation has released emergency patches; Cloudflare reported millions of exploit attempts against the two critical PHP vulnerabilities, including thousands before public disclosure; Amazon further reported that its MadPot honeypot observed exploitation attempts about four days before public disclosure, though it remains unclear how exploit information leaked during the embargo and no real-system compromise has been confirmed.
focus.latest_update_zh: 亚马逊威胁情报称，其 MadPot 蜜罐于 10 月 17 日观测到针对 PHP2Shell（CVE-2026-109618 与 CVE-2026-109619）的利用尝试，比公开披露早约四天；尝试来自与商业匿名网络相关的 IP，尚不清楚攻击者如何在禁运期内获得利用信息，也未证实真实系统已被攻破；亚马逊 CISO 称 AI 辅助分析正在缩短从补丁到可用利用的窗口。
focus.latest_update_en: Amazon threat intelligence said its MadPot honeypot observed exploitation attempts against PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) on October 17, about four days before public disclosure; attempts came from IPs associated with commercial anonymized networks, it is unclear how attackers obtained exploit information during the embargo, and no real-system compromise was confirmed; Amazon's CISO said AI-assisted analysis is shortening the patch-to-working-exploit window.
focus.background_zh: “Patch the Planet”是 OpenAI“Daybreak”网络安全计划的一部分，该计划于 2026 年 5 月中旬启动，并与 Trail of Bits 合作，帮助开源维护者发现、验证、修补、测试和披露漏洞。2026 年 7 月 9 日发布的 GPT-5.6 分为 Luna、Terra 和 Sol 三档，其中 Sol 为旗舰型号。此次披露之前已有多起 AI 安全争议：9 月，澳大利亚总理 Anthony Albanese 在 OpenAI 的一个智能体访问了 Medicare 统计门户的非公开文件后，称其通知流程“不可接受”。
focus.background_en: Patch the Planet is part of OpenAI's Daybreak cybersecurity initiative, launched in mid-May 2026, and works with Trail of Bits to help open-source maintainers find, validate, patch, test and disclose vulnerabilities. GPT-5.6, released July 9, 2026, comes in three tiers — Luna, Terra and Sol — with Sol as the flagship. The disclosure follows earlier AI-security disputes: in September, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese called OpenAI's notification process "unacceptable" after an OpenAI agent accessed non-public files on a Medicare statistics portal.
focus.latest_summary_zh: Amazon reports its MadPot honeypot detected exploitation attempts against the critical PHP2Shell PHP vulnerability (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, unauthenticated RCE affecting PHP 7.x and 8.x) about four days before details were publicly disclosed, with the flaw now widely exploited in the wild and AI-assisted analysis shortening the window from patch to working exploit.
focus.latest_summary_en: Amazon reports its MadPot honeypot detected exploitation attempts against the critical PHP2Shell PHP vulnerability (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, unauthenticated RCE affecting PHP 7.x and 8.x) about four days before details were publicly disclosed, with the flaw now widely exploited in the wild and AI-assisted analysis shortening the window from patch to working exploit.
focus.market_impact_zh: 由于 PHP 支撑着互联网的很大一部分——包括 Wiz 演示可被未授权利用的 WordPress、Drupal 和 Joomla 部署——运行这些技术栈的加密交易所、DeFi 前端和托管面板面临与迫使欧洲政府网站下线相同的暴露面。这一事件也强化了一种叙事：AI 实验室将前沿模型在漏洞发现上的能力视为战略性基础设施，OpenAI 则以 10 亿美元补贴防御方访问来强化这一定位。
focus.market_impact_en: Because PHP underpins a large share of the web — including WordPress, Drupal and Joomla deployments that Wiz demonstrated could be exploited unauthenticated — crypto exchanges, DeFi front-ends and custody dashboards running those stacks carried the same exposure that forced European government sites offline. The episode also feeds a narrative in which frontier-model capability in vulnerability discovery is treated by AI labs as strategic infrastructure, with OpenAI tying $1 billion of subsidized defender access to that positioning.

timeline.text_en: Amazon threat intelligence said its MadPot honeypot observed exploitation attempts against PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) on October 17, about four days before public disclosure; attempts came from IPs associated with commercial anonymized networks, it is unclear how attackers obtained exploit information during the embargo, and no real-system compromise was confirmed; Amazon's CISO said AI-assisted analysis is shortening the patch-to-working-exploit window.

timeline.text_en: Cloudflare reported millions of exploit attempts against two critical PHP vulnerabilities, including thousands before public disclosure, after the PHP Foundation released emergency patches and acknowledged resource shortages delayed a fix.

timeline.text_zh: 中国工业和信息化部网络安全威胁和漏洞信息共享平台（NVDB）针对同一组 PHP 远程代码执行超危漏洞发布风险提示，并列出受影响版本范围：8.5 系列＜8.5.12、8.4 系列＜8.4.27、8.3 系列＜8.3.36、8.2 系列＜8.2.35、8.1 系列及更早版本。
timeline.text_en: China's MIIT National Vulnerability Database (NVDB) issued a risk advisory for the same two critical PHP remote code execution vulnerabilities, listing affected version ranges: 8.5 < 8.5.12, 8.4 < 8.4.27, 8.3 < 8.3.36, 8.2 < 8.2.35, and 8.1 and earlier.

focus.title_zh: DeepSeek完成约1000亿元人民币第二轮融资，腾讯与宁德时代领投
focus.title_en: DeepSeek closes second RMB100B funding round led by Tencent and CATL
focus.summary_zh: DeepSeek 已完成约1000亿元人民币（约150亿美元）融资，宁德时代和腾讯等参投；融资目标曾从500亿元上调至800亿元，最终筹得约1000亿元。
focus.summary_en: DeepSeek has completed a funding round of about RMB100B (~$15B), with CATL, Tencent and others participating; the target was raised from RMB50B to RMB80B and ultimately reached about RMB100B.

focus.title_zh: 【Drift Protocol 攻击者向 Tornado Cash 转入 1.34 万枚以太坊】
focus.title_en: 【Drift Protocol 攻击者向 Tornado Cash 转入 1.34 万枚以太坊】
focus.summary_zh: Drift Protocol 攻击者持续通过 Tornado Cash 洗钱，10 月 20 日至 21 日累计存入 50,595 枚 ETH（约 1.22 亿美元），相关地址仍持有约 56,569 枚 ETH（约 1.39 亿美元）。
focus.summary_en: The Drift Protocol attacker continues laundering through Tornado Cash, with cumulative deposits on Oct 20–21 reaching 50,595 ETH (~$122M), while the related address still holds about 56,569 ETH (~$139M).
focus.latest_update_zh: Drift Protocol 攻击者在过去 1 小时内再向 Tornado Cash 存入 24,885 枚 ETH（约 6104 万美元），使其 10 月 20 日至 21 日累计存入量升至 50,595 枚 ETH（约 1.22 亿美元），地址仍持有约 56,569 枚 ETH（约 1.39 亿美元）。
focus.latest_update_en: The Drift Protocol attacker deposited another 24,885 ETH (~$61.04M) into Tornado Cash in the past hour, raising cumulative deposits on Oct 20–21 to 50,595 ETH (~$122M), while still holding about 56,569 ETH (~$139M).
focus.background_zh: Drift 是一家基于 Solana 的去中心化永续合约交易所，其 4 月 1 日遭到的攻击造成损失，安全顾问 Mandiant 将此次攻击归因于一个朝鲜威胁组织。10 月 1 日，该协议开放了 DFX 恢复代币的申领与赎回，使受损用户对一个初始规模约 310 万美元、并获得交易所收入和追回资金的资金池拥有求偿权。Tornado Cash 是一个开源、非托管的混币器，运行于兼容以太坊虚拟机的网络，用于模糊资金来源与目的地地址之间的关联。
focus.background_en: Drift, a Solana-based decentralized perpetual futures exchange, reported losses from the April 1 exploit, which its security consultant Mandiant attributed to a North Korean threat group. On Oct. 1 the protocol opened claims and redemptions for DFX recovery tokens, giving affected users a claim on a pool that launched with about $3.1 million and receives exchange revenue and recovered funds. Tornado Cash is an open-source, non-custodial mixer on Ethereum Virtual Machine-compatible networks that obscures the link between source and destination addresses.
focus.latest_summary_zh: The attacker behind the April Drift Protocol theft deposited another 24,885 ETH (~$61M) into Tornado Cash in the past hour, taking cumulative laundering on Oct 20–21 to 50,595 ETH (~$122M) while still holding roughly 56,569 ETH (~$139M).
focus.latest_summary_en: The attacker behind the April Drift Protocol theft deposited another 24,885 ETH (~$61M) into Tornado Cash in the past hour, taking cumulative laundering on Oct 20–21 to 50,595 ETH (~$122M) while still holding roughly 56,569 ETH (~$139M).
focus.market_impact_zh: 传导路径主要在合规与流动性层面，而非价格层面：大额 ETH 进入混币器会促使交易所、跨链桥和链上分析机构加强对可能与此次黑客事件相关存款的筛查；而仍未动用的 56,569 枚 ETH 则压低了市场对 Drift 的 DFX 求偿池回收规模的预期。
focus.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through compliance and liquidity rather than price: large ETH tranches entering a mixer push exchanges, bridges and analytics firms to tighten screening of deposits that may be tied to the hack, while the still-unmoved 56,569 ETH overhang keeps recovery expectations for Drift's DFX claim pool depressed.

timeline.text_en: The Drift Protocol attacker deposited another 24,885 ETH (~$61.04M) into Tornado Cash in the past hour, raising cumulative deposits on Oct 20–21 to 50,595 ETH (~$122M), while still holding about 56,569 ETH (~$139M).

timeline.text_zh: Drift Protocol 攻击者从另一长期休眠钱包向 Tornado Cash 再存入 4,600 枚 ETH（约 1123 万美元）；其追踪的两个关联钱包累计向 Tornado Cash 存入 30,310 枚 ETH，其中 0xaa8 开头地址累计存入 25,710 枚 ETH。
timeline.text_en: The Drift Protocol attacker deposited another 4,600 ETH (~$11.23M) into Tornado Cash from another previously dormant wallet, bringing the two tracked linked addresses to a combined 30,310 ETH deposited into the mixer; the 0xaa8 address alone accounts for 25,710 ETH.

timeline.text_zh: 攻击者向 Tornado Cash 的转入规模从上一次报告的至少 1.34 万枚 ETH 增至 2.57 万枚 ETH（约 6156 万美元），剩余持仓降至约 8.19 万枚 ETH（约 1.95 亿美元）。
timeline.text_en: The attacker's Tornado Cash deposits increased from the previously reported at least 13,400 ETH to 25,700 ETH (~$61.56M), with remaining holdings down to 81,864 ETH (~$195M).

focus.title_zh: MSCI 通过规则，可能将 Strategy 等投资控股公司剔除出全球股票指数
focus.title_en: Strategy Faces Fresh Threat of Removal from MSCI Global Equity Indexes
focus.summary_zh: MSCI已敲定非经营性公司指数排除规则，将于11月30日收盘生效，受影响名单11月11日公布；临时宽限措施被取消，Strategy和Metaplanet面临被剔除风险，被动基金可能被迫抛售；Metaplanet已进行BTC买卖操作以示主动管理，Strategy继续增持，Saylor批评规则具有歧视性。
focus.summary_en: MSCI has finalized the non-operating company exclusion rule, effective at the close of Nov. 30, with the affected list due Nov. 11; the temporary reprieve is scrapped, Strategy and Metaplanet face removal risk, and passive funds may be forced to sell; Metaplanet has executed BTC sales and buybacks to show active management, Strategy kept accumulating, and Saylor criticized the rule as discriminatory.
focus.latest_update_zh: MSCI新规将于11月30日收盘生效，并废除此前对数字资产占总资产50%以上公司的临时宽限；Metaplanet卖出1万枚BTC并回购1.1万枚以展示主动资金管理，Strategy则继续增持；Saylor称该规则具有歧视性。
focus.latest_update_en: The MSCI rule takes effect at the close of Nov. 30, and its temporary reprieve for companies with 50%+ digital-asset holdings is scrapped; Metaplanet sold 10,000 BTC and bought back 11,000 to demonstrate active treasury management, while Strategy kept accumulating; Saylor called the rule discriminatory.
focus.background_zh: 此次规则通过之前经历了一轮咨询，Strategy（MSTR）曾致信要求 MSCI 撤回该提案，称其只是把 MSCI 于 2026 年 1 月 6 日撤回的数字资产专项规则重新包装，相关内容由 CryptoTimes 报道。另据 TradingView 转载的 Cointelegraph 报道，一家比特币政策智库也对 MSCI 制定该提案的过程提出质疑。MSCI 全球可投资市场指数是包括 MSCI ACWI IMI 在内的基准指数的编制基础。
focus.background_en: The adoption follows a consultation in which Strategy (MSTR) asked MSCI to withdraw the proposal, describing it as a repackaging of a digital-asset-specific rule the index provider had withdrawn on January 6, 2026, according to a letter reported by CryptoTimes. A Bitcoin policy think tank has separately questioned how MSCI developed the proposal, per a Cointelegraph report carried by TradingView. MSCI's Global Investable Market Indexes underpin benchmarks including the MSCI ACWI IMI.
focus.latest_summary_zh: MSCI finalized rules that will exclude 'non-operating' Bitcoin-treasury companies like Strategy and Metaplanet from its Global Investable Market Indexes effective Nov. 30, potentially forcing passive funds to sell their shares and removing a key source of demand.
focus.latest_summary_en: MSCI finalized rules that will exclude 'non-operating' Bitcoin-treasury companies like Strategy and Metaplanet from its Global Investable Market Indexes effective Nov. 30, potentially forcing passive funds to sell their shares and removing a key source of demand.
focus.market_impact_zh: 传导路径来自指数纳入规则与被动资金流：若最终名单确认剔除，追踪 MSCI 全球可投资市场指数的基金将不得不减少对 MSTR、Metaplanet 等上市比特币储备型股票的持仓，从而影响这一作为 BTC 敞口主要上市代理标的板块的流动性与情绪。SharpLink 被列入观察名单，意味着另一批数字资产储备型股票同样处于这一审查流程之下。
focus.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through index inclusion rules and passive fund flows: if the final list confirms removals, funds tracking MSCI's Global Investable Market Indexes would have to reduce exposure to MSTR, Metaplanet and other listed bitcoin-treasury equities, affecting liquidity and sentiment in the segment that serves as the main listed proxy for BTC exposure. SharpLink's watchlist status keeps a second group of digital-asset treasury stocks exposed to the same review process.

focus.title_zh: 摩根大通将JPM Coin存款代币扩展至以太坊主网面向机构客户
focus.title_en: 【摩根大通正将 JPM Coin 存款代币扩展至以太坊，面向机构客户】
focus.summary_zh: JPM Coin 已在以太坊主网上线，面向经审核的机构客户用于支付、交易结算和抵押，并可在 Base 与以太坊之间转移。
focus.summary_en: JPM Coin is live on Ethereum mainnet for vetted institutional clients to use for payments, trade settlement and collateral, and can move between Base and Ethereum.
focus.latest_update_zh: 报道确认 JPM Coin 已在以太坊上线，而此前事件状态为扩展/报道阶段；并补充其可在 Base 与以太坊之间转移、仅限经审核对手方持有等细节。
focus.latest_update_en: The report confirms JPM Coin has launched on Ethereum, whereas the prior state was expansion/reporting; it adds that the token can move between Base and Ethereum and is restricted to vetted counterparties.
focus.background_zh: JPM Coin 是存款代币，即一种带有自定义功能的 ERC-20 代币，代表存放于摩根大通的资金，而非由私人发行方以储备资产支撑的稳定币。摩根大通在与万事达卡和 Coinbase 进行数月测试后，于 2025 年 11 月首次将该代币部署在 Base 上，并在今年 1 月表示还将把 JPM Coin 引入专注隐私的 Canton Network。该行还于 2025 年 12 月和 2026 年 5 月在以太坊上发行了两只代币化货币市场基金，并与稳定币发行方争夺同一批客户，其中包括由 Visa、Stripe 和万事达卡等 100 多家公司组成的财团——该财团上月推出了自己的美元稳定币。
focus.background_en: JPM Coin is a deposit token — an ERC-20 token with custom functions that represents funds deposited with JPMorgan — rather than a stablecoin backed by reserves held by a private issuer. JPMorgan first deployed the token on Base in November 2025 after months of testing with Mastercard and Coinbase, and in January said it would also bring JPM Coin to the privacy-focused Canton Network. The bank has additionally issued two tokenized money-market funds on Ethereum, in December 2025 and May 2026, and competes for the same customers as stablecoin issuers, including a consortium of more than 100 companies such as Visa, Stripe and Mastercard that launched its own dollar stablecoin last month.
focus.latest_summary_zh: JPMorgan launched JPM Coin on Ethereum, allowing institutional clients to redeem the token for dollars and use it for payments, trade settlement, and collateral posting.
focus.latest_summary_en: JPMorgan launched JPM Coin on Ethereum, allowing institutional clients to redeem the token for dollars and use it for payments, trade settlement, and collateral posting.
focus.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于结算与流动性：一种可在以太坊上生息的银行发行存款代币，为机构提供了在支付、代币化资产交易结算和抵押品方面替代稳定币的选择，可能使部分机构美元余额和链上活动转向基于以太坊的场所，同时在争夺同类企业与加密客户方面直接与稳定币发行方竞争。
focus.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through settlement and liquidity: a yield-bearing, bank-issued deposit token on Ethereum gives institutions an alternative to stablecoins for payments, tokenized-asset trade settlement and collateral, potentially shifting some institutional dollar balances and on-chain activity toward Ethereum-based venues while competing directly with stablecoin issuers for the same corporate and crypto-firm customers.

ranking.title_zh: OKX与ICE合资公司向SEC提交文件，规划代币化股票交易
ranking.title_en: OKX-ICE Joint Venture Files with SEC for Tokenized Stock Trading
ranking.summary_zh: OKXICE是OKX与ICE合资推进的代币化股票交易场所，已向SEC提交文件，并成为SEC披露的三家拟按创新豁免机制运营代币化证券交易场所的通知机构之一，计划使用X Layer网络；SEC强调列入名单不代表已满足豁免条件。该场所拟支持62家公司/63个股票代码的7×24小时代币化股票交易，通过AMM与流动性池撮合，并允许发行方提出异议。目前16家发行方已提出反对，纳斯达克也选择排除自身股票；OKX-ICE联席主席Andrew Cuomo称这一反对是正常且符合预期的反应。该场所尚未宣布上线日期，也并非SEC注册交易所。
ranking.summary_en: OKXICE, the OKX-ICE joint venture tokenized stock venue, has filed with the SEC and is one of three firms the SEC disclosed as having notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its innovation exemption, planning to use the X Layer network; the SEC stressed that being listed does not confirm eligibility. The venue plans to support 24/7 trading of 62 companies/63 tickers via AMMs and liquidity pools, with issuers allowed to object. Sixteen issuers have objected, and Nasdaq is opting its own shares out; OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo called the opposition normal and expected. No launch date has been announced and the venue is not an SEC-registered exchange.
ranking.latest_update_zh: SEC公开披露已有三家公司通知其计划按新创新豁免机制运营代币化证券交易场所，OKXICE为其中之一，并计划使用OKX旗下X Layer网络；SEC同时强调，列入名单不代表相关公司已满足豁免条件。
ranking.latest_update_en: The SEC publicly disclosed that three firms have notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its new innovation exemption, including OKXICE, which plans to use OKX's X Layer network; the SEC cautioned that being listed does not confirm eligibility for the exemption.
ranking.background_zh: 2026年1月28日，SEC公司金融部、投资管理部以及交易与市场部的工作人员发布联合声明，说明联邦证券法如何适用于代币化证券，包括通过分布式账本技术记录的发行人发起的代币化证券。OKX成立于2013年，原名Okcoin，2017年更名，按日交易量计算运营着规模最大的加密货币交易所之一。
ranking.background_en: On January 28, 2026, staff of the SEC's Divisions of Corporation Finance, Investment Management, and Trading and Markets issued a joint statement on how federal securities laws apply to tokenized securities, including issuer-sponsored tokenized securities recorded via distributed ledger technology. OKX, founded in 2013 as Okcoin and rebranded in 2017, operates one of the largest cryptocurrency exchanges by daily trading volume.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: The SEC disclosed that three firms — TSV LLC on Canton Network, the OKX–ICE joint venture OKXICE on X Layer, and Kephas Corp. on Kronos X — have notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its new innovation exemption, while cautioning that listing does not confirm eligibility.
ranking.latest_summary_en: The SEC disclosed that three firms — TSV LLC on Canton Network, the OKX–ICE joint venture OKXICE on X Layer, and Kephas Corp. on Kronos X — have notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its new innovation exemption, while cautioning that listing does not confirm eligibility.
ranking.market_impact_zh: 若该计划推进，股票敞口将通过加密交易场所撮合，使代币化股票产品、交易所交易量与托管安排与美国证券法对代币化股票的定性直接挂钩；SEC的这份文件正是这一传导路径的关键关口。
ranking.market_impact_en: The plan, if it proceeds, would route equity exposure through a crypto trading venue, linking tokenized-equity products, exchange trading volumes and custody arrangements to how US securities law treats tokenized shares; the SEC filing is the gate through which that transmission runs.
