timeline.text_en: OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo publicly responded to issuer opposition, calling the objections from 16 companies to their shares being tokenized a “normal reaction” and expected, while reiterating that the model lets issuers opt in or out.

timeline.text_zh: 微软、Alphabet、高盛、高通、卡特彼勒、麦当劳和西部数据这7家企业新提出反对，使已披露的反对发行方总数从9家增至16家（其中15家属于原62家公司名单，Cerebras不在最初名单内），OKXICE于10月19日更新了公开声明。
timeline.text_en: Seven more issuers — Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs, Qualcomm, Caterpillar, McDonald's and Western Digital — have objected, raising total disclosed objecting issuers from nine to 16 (15 of them on the original 62-company roster, with Cerebras outside that list), per the joint venture's 19 October updated public statement.

ranking.title_zh: PHP披露两个严重远程代码执行漏洞并发布紧急补丁
ranking.title_en: PHP discloses two critical RCE vulnerabilities and releases emergency patches
ranking.summary_zh: PHP 基金会已发布紧急补丁；Cloudflare 报告称针对两个关键 PHP 漏洞的利用尝试达数百万次，其中数千次发生在公开披露之前；亚马逊进一步报告其 MadPot 蜜罐在公开披露前约四天已观测到利用尝试，但尚不清楚禁运期内利用信息如何泄露，也未证实真实系统被攻破。
ranking.summary_en: The PHP Foundation has released emergency patches; Cloudflare reported millions of exploit attempts against the two critical PHP vulnerabilities, including thousands before public disclosure; Amazon further reported that its MadPot honeypot observed exploitation attempts about four days before public disclosure, though it remains unclear how exploit information leaked during the embargo and no real-system compromise has been confirmed.
ranking.latest_update_zh: 亚马逊威胁情报称，其 MadPot 蜜罐于 10 月 17 日观测到针对 PHP2Shell（CVE-2026-109618 与 CVE-2026-109619）的利用尝试，比公开披露早约四天；尝试来自与商业匿名网络相关的 IP，尚不清楚攻击者如何在禁运期内获得利用信息，也未证实真实系统已被攻破；亚马逊 CISO 称 AI 辅助分析正在缩短从补丁到可用利用的窗口。
ranking.latest_update_en: Amazon threat intelligence said its MadPot honeypot observed exploitation attempts against PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) on October 17, about four days before public disclosure; attempts came from IPs associated with commercial anonymized networks, it is unclear how attackers obtained exploit information during the embargo, and no real-system compromise was confirmed; Amazon's CISO said AI-assisted analysis is shortening the patch-to-working-exploit window.
ranking.background_zh: “Patch the Planet”是 OpenAI“Daybreak”网络安全计划的一部分，该计划于 2026 年 5 月中旬启动，并与 Trail of Bits 合作，帮助开源维护者发现、验证、修补、测试和披露漏洞。2026 年 7 月 9 日发布的 GPT-5.6 分为 Luna、Terra 和 Sol 三档，其中 Sol 为旗舰型号。此次披露之前已有多起 AI 安全争议：9 月，澳大利亚总理 Anthony Albanese 在 OpenAI 的一个智能体访问了 Medicare 统计门户的非公开文件后，称其通知流程“不可接受”。
ranking.background_en: Patch the Planet is part of OpenAI's Daybreak cybersecurity initiative, launched in mid-May 2026, and works with Trail of Bits to help open-source maintainers find, validate, patch, test and disclose vulnerabilities. GPT-5.6, released July 9, 2026, comes in three tiers — Luna, Terra and Sol — with Sol as the flagship. The disclosure follows earlier AI-security disputes: in September, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese called OpenAI's notification process "unacceptable" after an OpenAI agent accessed non-public files on a Medicare statistics portal.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: Amazon reports its MadPot honeypot detected exploitation attempts against the critical PHP2Shell PHP vulnerability (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, unauthenticated RCE affecting PHP 7.x and 8.x) about four days before details were publicly disclosed, with the flaw now widely exploited in the wild and AI-assisted analysis shortening the window from patch to working exploit.
ranking.latest_summary_en: Amazon reports its MadPot honeypot detected exploitation attempts against the critical PHP2Shell PHP vulnerability (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, unauthenticated RCE affecting PHP 7.x and 8.x) about four days before details were publicly disclosed, with the flaw now widely exploited in the wild and AI-assisted analysis shortening the window from patch to working exploit.
ranking.market_impact_zh: 由于 PHP 支撑着互联网的很大一部分——包括 Wiz 演示可被未授权利用的 WordPress、Drupal 和 Joomla 部署——运行这些技术栈的加密交易所、DeFi 前端和托管面板面临与迫使欧洲政府网站下线相同的暴露面。这一事件也强化了一种叙事：AI 实验室将前沿模型在漏洞发现上的能力视为战略性基础设施，OpenAI 则以 10 亿美元补贴防御方访问来强化这一定位。
ranking.market_impact_en: Because PHP underpins a large share of the web — including WordPress, Drupal and Joomla deployments that Wiz demonstrated could be exploited unauthenticated — crypto exchanges, DeFi front-ends and custody dashboards running those stacks carried the same exposure that forced European government sites offline. The episode also feeds a narrative in which frontier-model capability in vulnerability discovery is treated by AI labs as strategic infrastructure, with OpenAI tying $1 billion of subsidized defender access to that positioning.

timeline.text_zh: Cloudflare 报告称，针对两个关键 PHP 漏洞的利用尝试达数百万次，其中数千次发生在公开披露之前；此前 PHP 基金会发布了紧急补丁，并承认资源短缺导致修复延迟。
timeline.text_en: Cloudflare reported millions of exploit attempts against two critical PHP vulnerabilities, including thousands before public disclosure, after the PHP Foundation released emergency patches and acknowledged resource shortages delayed a fix.

timeline.text_zh: 中国工业和信息化部网络安全威胁和漏洞信息共享平台（NVDB）针对同一组 PHP 远程代码执行超危漏洞发布风险提示，并列出受影响版本范围：8.5 系列＜8.5.12、8.4 系列＜8.4.27、8.3 系列＜8.3.36、8.2 系列＜8.2.35、8.1 系列及更早版本。
timeline.text_en: China's MIIT National Vulnerability Database (NVDB) issued a risk advisory for the same two critical PHP remote code execution vulnerabilities, listing affected version ranges: 8.5 < 8.5.12, 8.4 < 8.4.27, 8.3 < 8.3.36, 8.2 < 8.2.35, and 8.1 and earlier.

ranking.title_zh: DeepSeek完成约1000亿元人民币第二轮融资，腾讯与宁德时代领投
ranking.title_en: DeepSeek closes second RMB100B funding round led by Tencent and CATL
ranking.summary_zh: DeepSeek 已完成约1000亿元人民币（约150亿美元）融资，宁德时代和腾讯等参投；融资目标曾从500亿元上调至800亿元，最终筹得约1000亿元。
ranking.summary_en: DeepSeek has completed a funding round of about RMB100B (~$15B), with CATL, Tencent and others participating; the target was raised from RMB50B to RMB80B and ultimately reached about RMB100B.
ranking.latest_update_zh: 融资状态从“据报道即将完成/接近完成”推进为“已完成”，规模约150亿美元（约1000亿元人民币），宁德时代和腾讯等参投。
ranking.latest_update_en: The funding round moved from reportedly nearing completion to completed, at about $15B (~RMB100B), with CATL, Tencent and others participating.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: DeepSeek closed a roughly $15 billion (RMB 100 billion) funding round with backing from CATL and Tencent, after raising its target twice from RMB 50 billion to RMB 80 billion before ultimately securing about RMB 100 billion.
ranking.latest_summary_en: DeepSeek closed a roughly $15 billion (RMB 100 billion) funding round with backing from CATL and Tencent, after raising its target twice from RMB 50 billion to RMB 80 billion before ultimately securing about RMB 100 billion.

timeline.text_zh: 融资状态从“据报道即将完成/接近完成”推进为“已完成”，规模约150亿美元（约1000亿元人民币），宁德时代和腾讯等参投。
timeline.text_en: The funding round moved from reportedly nearing completion to completed, at about $15B (~RMB100B), with CATL, Tencent and others participating.

timeline.text_zh: DeepSeek 完成第二轮 1000 亿元人民币融资，由腾讯和宁德时代领投，投前估值维持约 5000 亿元人民币不变，两轮融资总额约 1500 亿元人民币，同时准备最早于 2026 年底提交科创板 IPO 申请。
timeline.text_en: DeepSeek closed a second 100B RMB funding round led by Tencent and CATL at an unchanged ~500B RMB pre-money valuation, bringing two-round total to ~150B RMB, while preparing a STAR Market IPO filing as early as end-2026.

timeline.text_zh: 融资规模从此前报道的至少800亿元人民币进一步提高至约1000亿元人民币，投前估值仍约5000亿元人民币，新进产业投资方包括石溪资本、中芯聚源、CPE源峰、君联资本、吉利等。
timeline.text_en: The funding size increased from the previously reported at least ¥80B to roughly ¥100B, with the pre-money valuation unchanged at about ¥500B and new industrial investors including Shixi Capital, SMIC Capital, CPE, Legend Capital, and Geely.

ranking.title_zh: 【Drift Protocol 攻击者向 Tornado Cash 转入 1.34 万枚以太坊】
ranking.title_en: 【Drift Protocol 攻击者向 Tornado Cash 转入 1.34 万枚以太坊】
ranking.summary_zh: Drift Protocol 攻击者持续通过 Tornado Cash 洗钱，10 月 20 日至 21 日累计存入 50,595 枚 ETH（约 1.22 亿美元），相关地址仍持有约 56,569 枚 ETH（约 1.39 亿美元）。
ranking.summary_en: The Drift Protocol attacker continues laundering through Tornado Cash, with cumulative deposits on Oct 20–21 reaching 50,595 ETH (~$122M), while the related address still holds about 56,569 ETH (~$139M).
ranking.latest_update_zh: Drift Protocol 攻击者在过去 1 小时内再向 Tornado Cash 存入 24,885 枚 ETH（约 6104 万美元），使其 10 月 20 日至 21 日累计存入量升至 50,595 枚 ETH（约 1.22 亿美元），地址仍持有约 56,569 枚 ETH（约 1.39 亿美元）。
ranking.latest_update_en: The Drift Protocol attacker deposited another 24,885 ETH (~$61.04M) into Tornado Cash in the past hour, raising cumulative deposits on Oct 20–21 to 50,595 ETH (~$122M), while still holding about 56,569 ETH (~$139M).
ranking.background_zh: Drift 是一家基于 Solana 的去中心化永续合约交易所，其 4 月 1 日遭到的攻击造成损失，安全顾问 Mandiant 将此次攻击归因于一个朝鲜威胁组织。10 月 1 日，该协议开放了 DFX 恢复代币的申领与赎回，使受损用户对一个初始规模约 310 万美元、并获得交易所收入和追回资金的资金池拥有求偿权。Tornado Cash 是一个开源、非托管的混币器，运行于兼容以太坊虚拟机的网络，用于模糊资金来源与目的地地址之间的关联。
ranking.background_en: Drift, a Solana-based decentralized perpetual futures exchange, reported losses from the April 1 exploit, which its security consultant Mandiant attributed to a North Korean threat group. On Oct. 1 the protocol opened claims and redemptions for DFX recovery tokens, giving affected users a claim on a pool that launched with about $3.1 million and receives exchange revenue and recovered funds. Tornado Cash is an open-source, non-custodial mixer on Ethereum Virtual Machine-compatible networks that obscures the link between source and destination addresses.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: The attacker behind the April Drift Protocol theft deposited another 24,885 ETH (~$61M) into Tornado Cash in the past hour, taking cumulative laundering on Oct 20–21 to 50,595 ETH (~$122M) while still holding roughly 56,569 ETH (~$139M).
ranking.latest_summary_en: The attacker behind the April Drift Protocol theft deposited another 24,885 ETH (~$61M) into Tornado Cash in the past hour, taking cumulative laundering on Oct 20–21 to 50,595 ETH (~$122M) while still holding roughly 56,569 ETH (~$139M).
ranking.market_impact_zh: 传导路径主要在合规与流动性层面，而非价格层面：大额 ETH 进入混币器会促使交易所、跨链桥和链上分析机构加强对可能与此次黑客事件相关存款的筛查；而仍未动用的 56,569 枚 ETH 则压低了市场对 Drift 的 DFX 求偿池回收规模的预期。
ranking.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through compliance and liquidity rather than price: large ETH tranches entering a mixer push exchanges, bridges and analytics firms to tighten screening of deposits that may be tied to the hack, while the still-unmoved 56,569 ETH overhang keeps recovery expectations for Drift's DFX claim pool depressed.

timeline.text_zh: Drift Protocol 攻击者在过去 1 小时内再向 Tornado Cash 存入 24,885 枚 ETH（约 6104 万美元），使其 10 月 20 日至 21 日累计存入量升至 50,595 枚 ETH（约 1.22 亿美元），地址仍持有约 56,569 枚 ETH（约 1.39 亿美元）。
timeline.text_en: The Drift Protocol attacker deposited another 24,885 ETH (~$61.04M) into Tornado Cash in the past hour, raising cumulative deposits on Oct 20–21 to 50,595 ETH (~$122M), while still holding about 56,569 ETH (~$139M).

timeline.text_zh: Drift Protocol 攻击者从另一长期休眠钱包向 Tornado Cash 再存入 4,600 枚 ETH（约 1123 万美元）；其追踪的两个关联钱包累计向 Tornado Cash 存入 30,310 枚 ETH，其中 0xaa8 开头地址累计存入 25,710 枚 ETH。
timeline.text_en: The Drift Protocol attacker deposited another 4,600 ETH (~$11.23M) into Tornado Cash from another previously dormant wallet, bringing the two tracked linked addresses to a combined 30,310 ETH deposited into the mixer; the 0xaa8 address alone accounts for 25,710 ETH.

timeline.text_zh: 攻击者向 Tornado Cash 的转入规模从上一次报告的至少 1.34 万枚 ETH 增至 2.57 万枚 ETH（约 6156 万美元），剩余持仓降至约 8.19 万枚 ETH（约 1.95 亿美元）。
timeline.text_en: The attacker's Tornado Cash deposits increased from the previously reported at least 13,400 ETH to 25,700 ETH (~$61.56M), with remaining holdings down to 81,864 ETH (~$195M).

ranking.title_zh: MSCI 通过规则，可能将 Strategy 等投资控股公司剔除出全球股票指数
ranking.title_en: Strategy Faces Fresh Threat of Removal from MSCI Global Equity Indexes
ranking.summary_zh: MSCI已敲定非经营性公司指数排除规则，将于11月30日收盘生效，受影响名单11月11日公布；临时宽限措施被取消，Strategy和Metaplanet面临被剔除风险，被动基金可能被迫抛售；Metaplanet已进行BTC买卖操作以示主动管理，Strategy继续增持，Saylor批评规则具有歧视性。
ranking.summary_en: MSCI has finalized the non-operating company exclusion rule, effective at the close of Nov. 30, with the affected list due Nov. 11; the temporary reprieve is scrapped, Strategy and Metaplanet face removal risk, and passive funds may be forced to sell; Metaplanet has executed BTC sales and buybacks to show active management, Strategy kept accumulating, and Saylor criticized the rule as discriminatory.
ranking.latest_update_zh: MSCI新规将于11月30日收盘生效，并废除此前对数字资产占总资产50%以上公司的临时宽限；Metaplanet卖出1万枚BTC并回购1.1万枚以展示主动资金管理，Strategy则继续增持；Saylor称该规则具有歧视性。
ranking.latest_update_en: The MSCI rule takes effect at the close of Nov. 30, and its temporary reprieve for companies with 50%+ digital-asset holdings is scrapped; Metaplanet sold 10,000 BTC and bought back 11,000 to demonstrate active treasury management, while Strategy kept accumulating; Saylor called the rule discriminatory.
ranking.background_zh: 此次规则通过之前经历了一轮咨询，Strategy（MSTR）曾致信要求 MSCI 撤回该提案，称其只是把 MSCI 于 2026 年 1 月 6 日撤回的数字资产专项规则重新包装，相关内容由 CryptoTimes 报道。另据 TradingView 转载的 Cointelegraph 报道，一家比特币政策智库也对 MSCI 制定该提案的过程提出质疑。MSCI 全球可投资市场指数是包括 MSCI ACWI IMI 在内的基准指数的编制基础。
ranking.background_en: The adoption follows a consultation in which Strategy (MSTR) asked MSCI to withdraw the proposal, describing it as a repackaging of a digital-asset-specific rule the index provider had withdrawn on January 6, 2026, according to a letter reported by CryptoTimes. A Bitcoin policy think tank has separately questioned how MSCI developed the proposal, per a Cointelegraph report carried by TradingView. MSCI's Global Investable Market Indexes underpin benchmarks including the MSCI ACWI IMI.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: MSCI finalized rules that will exclude 'non-operating' Bitcoin-treasury companies like Strategy and Metaplanet from its Global Investable Market Indexes effective Nov. 30, potentially forcing passive funds to sell their shares and removing a key source of demand.
ranking.latest_summary_en: MSCI finalized rules that will exclude 'non-operating' Bitcoin-treasury companies like Strategy and Metaplanet from its Global Investable Market Indexes effective Nov. 30, potentially forcing passive funds to sell their shares and removing a key source of demand.
ranking.market_impact_zh: 传导路径来自指数纳入规则与被动资金流：若最终名单确认剔除，追踪 MSCI 全球可投资市场指数的基金将不得不减少对 MSTR、Metaplanet 等上市比特币储备型股票的持仓，从而影响这一作为 BTC 敞口主要上市代理标的板块的流动性与情绪。SharpLink 被列入观察名单，意味着另一批数字资产储备型股票同样处于这一审查流程之下。
ranking.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through index inclusion rules and passive fund flows: if the final list confirms removals, funds tracking MSCI's Global Investable Market Indexes would have to reduce exposure to MSTR, Metaplanet and other listed bitcoin-treasury equities, affecting liquidity and sentiment in the segment that serves as the main listed proxy for BTC exposure. SharpLink's watchlist status keeps a second group of digital-asset treasury stocks exposed to the same review process.

ranking.title_zh: 摩根大通将JPM Coin存款代币扩展至以太坊主网面向机构客户
ranking.title_en: 【摩根大通正将 JPM Coin 存款代币扩展至以太坊，面向机构客户】
ranking.summary_zh: JPM Coin 已在以太坊主网上线，面向经审核的机构客户用于支付、交易结算和抵押，并可在 Base 与以太坊之间转移。
ranking.summary_en: JPM Coin is live on Ethereum mainnet for vetted institutional clients to use for payments, trade settlement and collateral, and can move between Base and Ethereum.
ranking.latest_update_zh: 报道确认 JPM Coin 已在以太坊上线，而此前事件状态为扩展/报道阶段；并补充其可在 Base 与以太坊之间转移、仅限经审核对手方持有等细节。
ranking.latest_update_en: The report confirms JPM Coin has launched on Ethereum, whereas the prior state was expansion/reporting; it adds that the token can move between Base and Ethereum and is restricted to vetted counterparties.
ranking.background_zh: JPM Coin 是存款代币，即一种带有自定义功能的 ERC-20 代币，代表存放于摩根大通的资金，而非由私人发行方以储备资产支撑的稳定币。摩根大通在与万事达卡和 Coinbase 进行数月测试后，于 2025 年 11 月首次将该代币部署在 Base 上，并在今年 1 月表示还将把 JPM Coin 引入专注隐私的 Canton Network。该行还于 2025 年 12 月和 2026 年 5 月在以太坊上发行了两只代币化货币市场基金，并与稳定币发行方争夺同一批客户，其中包括由 Visa、Stripe 和万事达卡等 100 多家公司组成的财团——该财团上月推出了自己的美元稳定币。
ranking.background_en: JPM Coin is a deposit token — an ERC-20 token with custom functions that represents funds deposited with JPMorgan — rather than a stablecoin backed by reserves held by a private issuer. JPMorgan first deployed the token on Base in November 2025 after months of testing with Mastercard and Coinbase, and in January said it would also bring JPM Coin to the privacy-focused Canton Network. The bank has additionally issued two tokenized money-market funds on Ethereum, in December 2025 and May 2026, and competes for the same customers as stablecoin issuers, including a consortium of more than 100 companies such as Visa, Stripe and Mastercard that launched its own dollar stablecoin last month.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: JPMorgan launched JPM Coin on Ethereum, allowing institutional clients to redeem the token for dollars and use it for payments, trade settlement, and collateral posting.
ranking.latest_summary_en: JPMorgan launched JPM Coin on Ethereum, allowing institutional clients to redeem the token for dollars and use it for payments, trade settlement, and collateral posting.
ranking.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于结算与流动性：一种可在以太坊上生息的银行发行存款代币，为机构提供了在支付、代币化资产交易结算和抵押品方面替代稳定币的选择，可能使部分机构美元余额和链上活动转向基于以太坊的场所，同时在争夺同类企业与加密客户方面直接与稳定币发行方竞争。
ranking.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through settlement and liquidity: a yield-bearing, bank-issued deposit token on Ethereum gives institutions an alternative to stablecoins for payments, tokenized-asset trade settlement and collateral, potentially shifting some institutional dollar balances and on-chain activity toward Ethereum-based venues while competing directly with stablecoin issuers for the same corporate and crypto-firm customers.

featured.title_zh: OKX与ICE合资公司向SEC提交文件，规划代币化股票交易
featured.title_en: OKX-ICE Joint Venture Files with SEC for Tokenized Stock Trading
featured.summary_zh: OKXICE是OKX与ICE合资推进的代币化股票交易场所，已向SEC提交文件，并成为SEC披露的三家拟按创新豁免机制运营代币化证券交易场所的通知机构之一，计划使用X Layer网络；SEC强调列入名单不代表已满足豁免条件。该场所拟支持62家公司/63个股票代码的7×24小时代币化股票交易，通过AMM与流动性池撮合，并允许发行方提出异议。目前16家发行方已提出反对，纳斯达克也选择排除自身股票；OKX-ICE联席主席Andrew Cuomo称这一反对是正常且符合预期的反应。该场所尚未宣布上线日期，也并非SEC注册交易所。
featured.summary_en: OKXICE, the OKX-ICE joint venture tokenized stock venue, has filed with the SEC and is one of three firms the SEC disclosed as having notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its innovation exemption, planning to use the X Layer network; the SEC stressed that being listed does not confirm eligibility. The venue plans to support 24/7 trading of 62 companies/63 tickers via AMMs and liquidity pools, with issuers allowed to object. Sixteen issuers have objected, and Nasdaq is opting its own shares out; OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo called the opposition normal and expected. No launch date has been announced and the venue is not an SEC-registered exchange.
featured.latest_update_zh: SEC公开披露已有三家公司通知其计划按新创新豁免机制运营代币化证券交易场所，OKXICE为其中之一，并计划使用OKX旗下X Layer网络；SEC同时强调，列入名单不代表相关公司已满足豁免条件。
featured.latest_update_en: The SEC publicly disclosed that three firms have notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its new innovation exemption, including OKXICE, which plans to use OKX's X Layer network; the SEC cautioned that being listed does not confirm eligibility for the exemption.
featured.background_zh: 2026年1月28日，SEC公司金融部、投资管理部以及交易与市场部的工作人员发布联合声明，说明联邦证券法如何适用于代币化证券，包括通过分布式账本技术记录的发行人发起的代币化证券。OKX成立于2013年，原名Okcoin，2017年更名，按日交易量计算运营着规模最大的加密货币交易所之一。
featured.background_en: On January 28, 2026, staff of the SEC's Divisions of Corporation Finance, Investment Management, and Trading and Markets issued a joint statement on how federal securities laws apply to tokenized securities, including issuer-sponsored tokenized securities recorded via distributed ledger technology. OKX, founded in 2013 as Okcoin and rebranded in 2017, operates one of the largest cryptocurrency exchanges by daily trading volume.
featured.latest_summary_zh: The SEC disclosed that three firms — TSV LLC on Canton Network, the OKX–ICE joint venture OKXICE on X Layer, and Kephas Corp. on Kronos X — have notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its new innovation exemption, while cautioning that listing does not confirm eligibility.
featured.latest_summary_en: The SEC disclosed that three firms — TSV LLC on Canton Network, the OKX–ICE joint venture OKXICE on X Layer, and Kephas Corp. on Kronos X — have notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its new innovation exemption, while cautioning that listing does not confirm eligibility.
featured.market_impact_zh: 若该计划推进，股票敞口将通过加密交易场所撮合，使代币化股票产品、交易所交易量与托管安排与美国证券法对代币化股票的定性直接挂钩；SEC的这份文件正是这一传导路径的关键关口。
featured.market_impact_en: The plan, if it proceeds, would route equity exposure through a crypto trading venue, linking tokenized-equity products, exchange trading volumes and custody arrangements to how US securities law treats tokenized shares; the SEC filing is the gate through which that transmission runs.

featured.title_zh: PHP披露两个严重远程代码执行漏洞并发布紧急补丁
featured.title_en: PHP discloses two critical RCE vulnerabilities and releases emergency patches
featured.summary_zh: PHP 基金会已发布紧急补丁；Cloudflare 报告称针对两个关键 PHP 漏洞的利用尝试达数百万次，其中数千次发生在公开披露之前；亚马逊进一步报告其 MadPot 蜜罐在公开披露前约四天已观测到利用尝试，但尚不清楚禁运期内利用信息如何泄露，也未证实真实系统被攻破。
featured.summary_en: The PHP Foundation has released emergency patches; Cloudflare reported millions of exploit attempts against the two critical PHP vulnerabilities, including thousands before public disclosure; Amazon further reported that its MadPot honeypot observed exploitation attempts about four days before public disclosure, though it remains unclear how exploit information leaked during the embargo and no real-system compromise has been confirmed.
featured.latest_update_zh: 亚马逊威胁情报称，其 MadPot 蜜罐于 10 月 17 日观测到针对 PHP2Shell（CVE-2026-109618 与 CVE-2026-109619）的利用尝试，比公开披露早约四天；尝试来自与商业匿名网络相关的 IP，尚不清楚攻击者如何在禁运期内获得利用信息，也未证实真实系统已被攻破；亚马逊 CISO 称 AI 辅助分析正在缩短从补丁到可用利用的窗口。
featured.latest_update_en: Amazon threat intelligence said its MadPot honeypot observed exploitation attempts against PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) on October 17, about four days before public disclosure; attempts came from IPs associated with commercial anonymized networks, it is unclear how attackers obtained exploit information during the embargo, and no real-system compromise was confirmed; Amazon's CISO said AI-assisted analysis is shortening the patch-to-working-exploit window.
featured.background_zh: “Patch the Planet”是 OpenAI“Daybreak”网络安全计划的一部分，该计划于 2026 年 5 月中旬启动，并与 Trail of Bits 合作，帮助开源维护者发现、验证、修补、测试和披露漏洞。2026 年 7 月 9 日发布的 GPT-5.6 分为 Luna、Terra 和 Sol 三档，其中 Sol 为旗舰型号。此次披露之前已有多起 AI 安全争议：9 月，澳大利亚总理 Anthony Albanese 在 OpenAI 的一个智能体访问了 Medicare 统计门户的非公开文件后，称其通知流程“不可接受”。
featured.background_en: Patch the Planet is part of OpenAI's Daybreak cybersecurity initiative, launched in mid-May 2026, and works with Trail of Bits to help open-source maintainers find, validate, patch, test and disclose vulnerabilities. GPT-5.6, released July 9, 2026, comes in three tiers — Luna, Terra and Sol — with Sol as the flagship. The disclosure follows earlier AI-security disputes: in September, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese called OpenAI's notification process "unacceptable" after an OpenAI agent accessed non-public files on a Medicare statistics portal.
featured.latest_summary_zh: Amazon reports its MadPot honeypot detected exploitation attempts against the critical PHP2Shell PHP vulnerability (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, unauthenticated RCE affecting PHP 7.x and 8.x) about four days before details were publicly disclosed, with the flaw now widely exploited in the wild and AI-assisted analysis shortening the window from patch to working exploit.
featured.latest_summary_en: Amazon reports its MadPot honeypot detected exploitation attempts against the critical PHP2Shell PHP vulnerability (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, unauthenticated RCE affecting PHP 7.x and 8.x) about four days before details were publicly disclosed, with the flaw now widely exploited in the wild and AI-assisted analysis shortening the window from patch to working exploit.
featured.market_impact_zh: 由于 PHP 支撑着互联网的很大一部分——包括 Wiz 演示可被未授权利用的 WordPress、Drupal 和 Joomla 部署——运行这些技术栈的加密交易所、DeFi 前端和托管面板面临与迫使欧洲政府网站下线相同的暴露面。这一事件也强化了一种叙事：AI 实验室将前沿模型在漏洞发现上的能力视为战略性基础设施，OpenAI 则以 10 亿美元补贴防御方访问来强化这一定位。
featured.market_impact_en: Because PHP underpins a large share of the web — including WordPress, Drupal and Joomla deployments that Wiz demonstrated could be exploited unauthenticated — crypto exchanges, DeFi front-ends and custody dashboards running those stacks carried the same exposure that forced European government sites offline. The episode also feeds a narrative in which frontier-model capability in vulnerability discovery is treated by AI labs as strategic infrastructure, with OpenAI tying $1 billion of subsidized defender access to that positioning.

timeline.text_en: China's MIIT National Vulnerability Database (NVDB) issued a risk advisory for the same two critical PHP remote code execution vulnerabilities, listing affected version ranges: 8.5 < 8.5.12, 8.4 < 8.4.27, 8.3 < 8.3.36, 8.2 < 8.2.35, and 8.1 and earlier.

featured.title_en: DeepSeek closes second RMB100B funding round led by Tencent and CATL
featured.summary_zh: DeepSeek 已完成约1000亿元人民币（约150亿美元）融资，宁德时代和腾讯等参投；融资目标曾从500亿元上调至800亿元，最终筹得约1000亿元。

featured.latest_update_en: The funding round moved from reportedly nearing completion to completed, at about $15B (~RMB100B), with CATL, Tencent and others participating.
featured.latest_summary_zh: DeepSeek closed a roughly $15 billion (RMB 100 billion) funding round with backing from CATL and Tencent, after raising its target twice from RMB 50 billion to RMB 80 billion before ultimately securing about RMB 100 billion.
featured.latest_summary_en: DeepSeek closed a roughly $15 billion (RMB 100 billion) funding round with backing from CATL and Tencent, after raising its target twice from RMB 50 billion to RMB 80 billion before ultimately securing about RMB 100 billion.

timeline.text_en: The funding round moved from reportedly nearing completion to completed, at about $15B (~RMB100B), with CATL, Tencent and others participating.

timeline.text_zh: DeepSeek 完成第二轮 1000 亿元人民币融资，由腾讯和宁德时代领投，投前估值维持约 5000 亿元人民币不变，两轮融资总额约 1500 亿元人民币，同时准备最早于 2026 年底提交科创板 IPO 申请。
timeline.text_en: DeepSeek closed a second 100B RMB funding round led by Tencent and CATL at an unchanged ~500B RMB pre-money valuation, bringing two-round total to ~150B RMB, while preparing a STAR Market IPO filing as early as end-2026.

timeline.text_zh: 融资规模从此前报道的至少800亿元人民币进一步提高至约1000亿元人民币，投前估值仍约5000亿元人民币，新进产业投资方包括石溪资本、中芯聚源、CPE源峰、君联资本、吉利等。
timeline.text_en: The funding size increased from the previously reported at least ¥80B to roughly ¥100B, with the pre-money valuation unchanged at about ¥500B and new industrial investors including Shixi Capital, SMIC Capital, CPE, Legend Capital, and Geely.

dormant.title_zh: Payward 收购立陶宛 Saldo 银行以获取欧盟银行牌照
dormant.title_en: Payward to acquire Lithuania-based Saldo Bank for EU banking license
dormant.latest_update_zh: CoinDesk 报道补充：该交易据 Financial Times 称为加密公司首次收购欧洲银行；Saldo Bank 2025 年底总资产约 1.639 亿欧元（1.8 亿美元）；Payward 计划提供有息存款、贷款、卡服务和欧元支付；其银行业务已发放逾 20 亿美元贷款，并持有美联储有限用途主账户和爱尔兰电子货币机构牌照。
dormant.latest_update_en: CoinDesk adds that the deal is reportedly the first acquisition of a European bank by a crypto company according to the Financial Times; Saldo Bank had €163.9 million ($180 million) in total assets at end-2025; Payward plans to offer interest-bearing deposits, loans, card services and euro payments; its banking business has originated over $2 billion in loans and holds a Federal Reserve limited-purpose master account and an Irish electronic money institution license.

dormant.title_zh: 欧盟将 Circle 发行的 USDC 认定为首个“重要”电子货币代币，Circle 欧洲赎回政策允许临时延迟
dormant.title_en: Circle can delay European USDC redemptions if reserves cannot cross borders
dormant.latest_update_zh: 欧洲银行管理局将 Circle 发行的 USDC 指定为欧盟首个 MiCA 下的“重要”电子货币代币，自 2026 年 11 月 12 日起，将其资本、储备、流动性及恢复/赎回计划的直接监管权从法国 ACPR 移交至 EBA，并配套签署新的 EBA–NYDFS 合作备忘录。
dormant.latest_update_en: The European Banking Authority designated Circle-issued USDC as the EU's first 'significant' e-money token under MiCA, transferring direct supervision of its capital, reserves, liquidity and recovery/redemption plans to the EBA from France's ACPR starting 12 November 2026, and paired with a new EBA–NYDFS cooperation memorandum.

dormant.title_zh: 渣打银行在阿联酋推出比特币和以太坊现货交易
dormant.title_en: Standard Chartered launches spot Bitcoin and Ether trading in the UAE
dormant.latest_update_zh: 渣打银行将其在阿联酋的比特币和以太币现货交易扩展至专业投资者，符合条件的客户可在现有银行账户内交易；资格要求净资产至少400万迪拉姆（约110万美元），并计划进一步扩大准入。
dormant.latest_update_en: Standard Chartered expanded its spot Bitcoin and Ether trading in the UAE to professional investors, allowing eligible clients to trade within existing bank accounts; eligibility requires at least AED 4 million (~$1.1M) in net assets, and the bank plans to broaden access further.

dormant.title_zh: Strategy斥资9.508亿美元回购STRC，远超同期比特币买入
dormant.title_en: Strategy prioritizes $950 million STRC buyback over expanding its Bitcoin treasury
dormant.latest_update_zh: 截至2026年10月11日，Strategy的USD Cash从8月30日的16.1亿美元降至6.405亿美元，降幅60%；20亿美元STRC回购授权仅剩3.548亿美元；独立USD Reserve同期从51.0亿美元降至48.8亿美元。按近七周约9.7亿美元的消耗速度，若不补充，USD Cash约四周内耗尽。
dormant.latest_update_en: As of Oct 11, 2026, Strategy's USD Cash fell 60% from $1.61B on Aug 30 to $640.5M; only $354.8M of its $2B STRC buyback authorization remained; the separate USD Reserve declined from $5.10B to $4.88B. At the ~$970M burn pace over less than seven weeks, USD Cash could run out in about four weeks absent replenishment.

dormant.title_zh: OpenAI正洽谈收购加密安全公司Trail of Bits
dormant.title_en: OpenAI正洽谈收购加密安全公司Trail of Bits
dormant.latest_update_zh: 收购谈判被报道是由一起安全事件引发的：OpenAI会议室发现隐藏录音设备，一名工程师已被FBI逮捕。
dormant.latest_update_en: The acquisition talks are reported to be motivated by a security incident: a hidden recording device found in an OpenAI conference room, with an engineer arrested by the FBI.

dormant.title_zh: 【StarkWare 推出 OffMarket，支持 Polymarket 用户进行隐私交易】
dormant.title_en: 【StarkWare 推出 OffMarket，支持 Polymarket 用户进行隐私交易】
dormant.latest_update_zh: OffMarket 已向公众开放（此前自8月起小范围试用），基于 Starknet 零知识共享隐私池；合约经 OpenZeppelin 审计并完成形式化验证；目前每账户存款上限 1000 USDC，池内约 150 万美元、1.7 万笔存款；服务非 Polymarket 官方产品，属其验证 Builder 计划，沿用地理限制包括禁止美国用户；独立合规机构 Financial Privacy Inc. 保管主查看密钥用于制裁筛查及合法披露。
dormant.latest_update_en: OffMarket is now open to the public (following a limited trial since August), based on a Starknet zero-knowledge shared privacy pool; contracts audited by OpenZeppelin and formally verified; current deposit cap of 1,000 USDC per account, with about $1.5M and 17k deposits in the pool; not an official Polymarket product, part of its verified Builder program, subject to geographic restrictions including a U.S. ban; independent compliance firm Financial Privacy Inc. holds the master viewing key for sanctions screening and lawful disclosure.

dormant.title_zh: 加密硬件钱包遭攻击，估计损失7000万美元
dormant.title_en: Crypto Hardware Wallets Hit in Estimated $70 Million Attack
dormant.latest_update_zh: Ledger 确认通过授权经销商 CryptoBilis 售出的一台受影响设备含有未授权植入模块；这些恶意植入模块会截取用户助记词并通过蜂窝网络传输。Trezor 也宣布作为预防措施减少经销商数量。
dormant.latest_update_en: Ledger confirmed that one affected device sold through authorized reseller CryptoBilis contained an unauthorized implant; the malicious implants captured users’ recovery phrases and transmitted them over cellular networks. Trezor also announced it would reduce resellers as a preventive step.

dormant.title_zh: 荷兰央行授予Qivalis电子货币牌照，用于符合MiCA的欧元代币
dormant.title_en: Dutch central bank grants Qivalis e-money license for MiCA-compliant euro token
dormant.latest_update_zh: 披露 Qivalis 由 37 家欧洲主要银行支持，需满足 MiCA 其余要求（包括发布白皮书）后方可发行代币，计划未来几个月内发行，并通过银行、加密货币交易所和支付服务提供商分发，而非直接面向消费者。
dormant.latest_update_en: Disclosed that Qivalis is backed by 37 major European banks, must meet remaining MiCA requirements including publishing a whitepaper before token issuance, plans issuance in coming months, and will distribute via banks, crypto exchanges and payment service providers rather than directly to consumers.

dormant.title_zh: 【Polygon Labs 已完成对 Coinme 的收购】
dormant.title_en: 【Polygon Labs 已完成对 Coinme 的收购】
dormant.latest_update_zh: 新增监管覆盖细节：OMS 已覆盖美国 48 个州，持有 37 张州级货币转账牌照、11 项豁免资格，并在 FinCEN 注册为货币服务业务机构。
dormant.latest_update_en: Added regulatory coverage details: OMS covers 48 US states with 37 state money transmitter licenses, 11 exemptions, and FinCEN MSB registration.

dormant.title_zh: Evernorth 通过与 Armada 合并登陆纳斯达克并选定机构合作伙伴部署 XRP 储备
dormant.title_en: Evernorth shareholders approve $1 billion XRP treasury deal, clearing path to Nasdaq debut
dormant.latest_update_zh: 纳斯达克上市的Evernorth已选择Ripple、Kraken、Coinbase和BitGo作为其首批机构合作伙伴，从第四季度开始部署约4.73亿枚XRP（约6.48亿美元），后续将扩展到XRP Ledger借贷和链上DeFi策略，由前Coinbase Asset Management联合首席投资官Hugo Jeandesboz领导。
dormant.latest_update_en: Nasdaq-listed Evernorth has selected Ripple, Kraken, Coinbase and BitGo as its first institutional partners to deploy roughly 473 million XRP (about $648 million) starting in Q4, with later expansion into XRP Ledger lending and on-chain DeFi strategies led by former Coinbase Asset Management co-CIO Hugo Jeandesboz.

dormant.title_zh: BNY与Citadel Securities测试代币化美国国债，以加速华尔街融资
dormant.title_en: BNY, Citadel Securities test tokenized U.S. Treasuries to speed up Wall Street financing
dormant.latest_update_zh: 新报道明确该交易是主要三方回购平台上首笔使用代币化资产的三方回购：Citadel Securities经BNY在Tradeweb买入一只2年期美国国债，BNY在其私有数字账本上记录代币化版本并在数分钟内完成交割，随后Citadel将该代币化国债作为隔夜三方回购抵押品从BNY获得现金。
dormant.latest_update_en: The new report specifies the transaction was the first tri-party repo on a major platform using a tokenized asset: Citadel Securities bought a 2-year U.S. Treasury via BNY on Tradeweb, BNY recorded a tokenized version on its private digital ledger and settled in minutes, then Citadel used the tokenized Treasury as collateral for an overnight tri-party repo to obtain cash from BNY.

dormant.title_zh: OKX分阶段上线统一代币化股票现货交易
dormant.title_en: OKX rolls out unified tokenized stock spot trading in phases
dormant.latest_update_zh: OKX 将上线统一代币化股票现货交易对，包括 xSHLD 和 xSQQQ，由 xStocks（Backed Assets）支持，以 USDT 报价 24/7 交易，并支持在 Solana 和 X Layer 上充提。
dormant.latest_update_en: OKX will list unified tokenized stock spot pairs including xSHLD and xSQQQ, backed by xStocks (Backed Assets), with 24/7 USDT-quoted trading and deposits/withdrawals on Solana and X Layer.

dormant.title_zh: Blast宣布关停L2主网，因维护成本超过收入
dormant.title_en: Blast announces shutdown of its L2 mainnet as maintenance costs exceed revenue
dormant.latest_update_zh: Upbit 具体说明将于当地时间 10 月 26 日 12:00 下架 BLAST 现货交易。
dormant.latest_update_en: Upbit specified that it will delist BLAST spot trading on October 26 at 12:00 local time.

dormant.title_zh: Anthropic 重新设计源代码管理
dormant.title_en: Redesigning source control at Anthropic
dormant.latest_update_zh: 补充确认Anthropic主仓库已从Git迁出，迁移至自研版本控制系统Scion；该系统由7名工程师借助Claude在5个月内开发，并配套推出代码审查工具Antique。
dormant.latest_update_en: Added confirmation that Anthropic migrated its main repository off Git to the purpose-built VCS Scion, developed by 7 engineers over 5 months with Claude assistance, alongside a code review tool called Antique.

dormant.title_zh: 【钱志敏 400 亿非法集资案进展：检方申请没收 6.18 万余枚比特币等资产，法院已受理】
dormant.title_en: 【钱志敏 400 亿非法集资案进展：检方申请没收 6.18 万余枚比特币等资产，法院已受理】
dormant.latest_update_zh: 天津二中院于9月28日立案受理该没收申请，并于10月13日发布公告；同时披露了更详细的没收财产清单，包括72,745.79502枚BCH、72,745.78555枚BSV、72,745.7845枚BCH（中本聪愿景）、3,605,989.9995枚XRP、70,081,208.62553222枚DOGE（已由英国司法机关转换后存入计息账户）以及美元、欧元、英镑现金、珠宝、银行余额和投资组合等。
dormant.latest_update_en: The Tianjin No. 2 Intermediate Court accepted the confiscation application on Sept 28 and issued an announcement on Oct 13; it also disclosed a more detailed asset list including 72,745.79502 BCH, 72,745.78555 BSV, 72,745.7845 BCH (Satoshi Vision), 3,605,989.9995 XRP, 70,081,208.62553222 DOGE (converted by UK judicial authorities into an interest-bearing account), plus USD, EUR, GBP cash, jewelry, bank balances and investment portfolios.

dormant.title_zh: Coinbase 推进比特币托管的后量子密码学方案
dormant.title_en: Coinbase Advances Post-Quantum Cryptography Plan for Bitcoin Custody
dormant.latest_update_zh: Coinbase 发布了一项提案，敦促比特币立即开始为量子计算做准备，建议采用灵活的后量子签名方案、分阶段采用、备份量子安全密钥，并将休眠或迁移延迟钱包的争议作为单独议题处理。
dormant.latest_update_en: Coinbase published a proposal urging Bitcoin to begin preparing for quantum computers now, recommending flexible post-quantum signature schemes, staged adoption, a backup quantum-proof key, and treating dormant or late-migrating wallets as a separate debate.

dormant.title_zh: Metaplanet 拟发行约 520 亿日元零息可转债，用于偿还比特币担保借款及回购股份
dormant.title_en: 【Metaplanet 拟发行约 3.33 亿美元零息可转债，用于还款及回购股票】
dormant.latest_update_zh: Metaplanet CEO Simon Gerovich 将以0.75%年利率出借最多5500万股个人持股，以降低机构投资者对冲借券成本并优化债券发行条件；8月18日宣布的对Super League Enterprise（SLE）的投资预计很快完成，但需经SLE股东大会批准并满足其他交割条件，交易完成后SLE计划更名为Superplanet, Inc.。
dormant.latest_update_en: Metaplanet CEO Simon Gerovich will lend up to 55 million personal shares at 0.75% annual interest to reduce institutional hedging borrowing costs and optimize bond issuance conditions; the August 18 announced investment in Super League Enterprise (SLE) is expected to complete soon, subject to SLE shareholder approval and other closing conditions, after which SLE plans to rename to Superplanet, Inc.

dormant.title_zh: 菲律宾央行限制银行向主要加密平台Coins.ph转账
dormant.title_en: Philippine Central Bank Curbs Bank Transfers to Major Crypto Platform Coins ph
dormant.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充称 Coins.ph 多名合规高管离职，包括首席合规官及反洗钱监控负责人，并披露其拥有超 1800 万用户、日现货交易量约 5000 万美元、控制菲律宾约 75%-80% 比索兑稳定币流动性。
dormant.latest_update_en: New reporting adds that multiple Coins.ph compliance executives have departed, including the chief compliance officer and AML monitoring head, and discloses it has over 18 million users, about $50 million daily spot volume, and controls roughly 75%-80% of Philippine peso-to-stablecoin liquidity.

dormant.title_zh: IMF发现：代币化股票需求真实，但仍波动剧烈且流动性不足
dormant.title_en: Tokenized Stocks Show Real Demand But Remain Volatile and Illiquid, IMF Finds
dormant.latest_update_zh: IMF 10月《全球金融稳定报告》首次用专门章节讨论代币化市场：截至7月底，不含回购和稳定币的代币化RWA公开市场规模约650亿美元（信贷约304亿、货币市场基金约175亿、股票约23亿），代币化回购30日平均日交易量达3030亿美元；并警告代币化资产可能成为杠杆积累及流动性与期限错配的新渠道，以及稳定币/代币化存款作为主要结算工具带来的发行方信用风险和集中度风险。
dormant.latest_update_en: The IMF’s October GFSR dedicates its first special chapter to tokenization: tokenized RWA public market (ex repo/stablecoins) was ~$65B as of end-July (credit ~$30.4B, MMFs ~$17.5B, equities ~$2.3B) with tokenized repo 30-day average daily volume at $303B; it warns tokenized assets could become a new channel for leverage and liquidity/maturity mismatches, and flags stablecoin/tokenized-deposit settlement concentration/credit risks.

dormant.title_zh: Sui Devnet新增后量子签名支持，目标2027年一季度主网上线
dormant.title_en: Sui Devnet Adds Post-Quantum Signature Support, Targets Mainnet Rollout in Q1 20
dormant.latest_update_zh: 后续报道确认 ML-DSA-65 在 Devnet 协议版本 139 中作为原生账户签名方案加入，单签和多签账户均支持，验证者可验证后量子密钥授权交易；测试网和主网目前仍不接受此类签名，主网时间取决于独立审计和测试网反馈。
dormant.latest_update_en: Follow-up reporting confirms ML-DSA-65 was added as a native account signature scheme in Devnet protocol version 139, supporting single- and multi-signature accounts, with validators able to verify transactions authorized by post-quantum keys; Testnet and Mainnet still do not accept such signatures, and Mainnet timing depends on independent audits and Testnet feedback.

dormant.title_zh: 【Starknet 推出隐私原语 Shadow Accounts，应用可提供隐私模式切换】
dormant.title_en: 【Starknet 推出隐私原语 Shadow Accounts，应用可提供隐私模式切换】
dormant.latest_update_zh: 补充说明影子账户是由受保护 STRK20 余额注资的独立伪名 Starknet 地址，用于在隐藏与主钱包关联的前提下参与公开 DeFi 活动；首个集成计划于次日上线。
dormant.latest_update_en: Added that Shadow Accounts are pseudonymous Starknet addresses funded from shielded STRK20 balances for public DeFi activity while concealing the link to the main wallet; the first integration is scheduled for the next day.

dormant.title_zh: Gemini 4 Argon：我们通往前沿智能的下一个时代
dormant.title_en: Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence
dormant.latest_update_zh: 谷歌宣布通过付费版 Gemini API 向全球开发者和企业正式推出 Gemini 4 Argon，并同时开放 Google AI Ultra 订阅使用。这标志着此前受限的 Fairwind Program 首发阶段结束，进入面向开发者/企业的普遍可用阶段。
dormant.latest_update_en: Google announced the general availability of Gemini 4 Argon through the paid Gemini API for developers and enterprises worldwide, as well as via the Google AI Ultra subscription. This marks the end of the earlier restricted Fairwind Program-only phase and the start of broad developer/enterprise access.

dormant.title_zh: 俄罗斯央行发放首批加密货币交易所与托管机构牌照
dormant.title_en: Russia's central bank issues first crypto exchange and custodian licenses
dormant.latest_update_zh: 俄罗斯央行授权Sberbank（以及VTB等公司）作为持牌加密货币交易所运营商和托管机构，该银行准备从2026年12月1日起通过其平台提供BTC、ETH和USDT交易。
dormant.latest_update_en: Russia's central bank authorized Sberbank (alongside VTB and other firms) as a licensed crypto exchange operator and custodian, with the lender preparing to offer BTC, ETH and USDT trading through its platforms starting Dec. 1, 2026.

dormant.title_zh: Anthropic 警告自主复制型 AI 蠕虫可能通过消费级物联网设备传播
dormant.title_en: Anthropic warns self-replicating AI worms may spread across consumer IoT devices
dormant.latest_update_zh: Anthropic的研究警告称，AI可能像计算机蠕虫一样在廉价消费设备间传播，研究显示GLM-5.2在模拟网络中自主完成发现-传输-运行-传播循环，Qwen3.5-9B在9种硬件类型中的8种上自我部署，而失败学习将部署成功率从45%提升至61–84%。
dormant.latest_update_en: Anthropic research warns that AI could spread like a computer worm across cheap consumer devices, showing GLM-5.2 autonomously completing a find-transfer-run-propagate loop in a simulated network, Qwen3.5-9B self-deploying on 8 of 9 hardware types, and failure-learning raising deployment success from 45% to 61–84%.

dormant.title_zh: 英国高等法院裁决后，英国保留38亿英镑比特币查获资产的可能性上升
dormant.title_en: UK chances of keeping £3.8bn bitcoin haul rise after High Court ruling
dormant.latest_update_zh: 伦敦高等法院进一步明确，该案 61,000 BTC（约 50 亿美元/38 亿英镑）受害者索赔适用中国法律；受害者律师计划上诉，所有权归属留待后续程序。
dormant.latest_update_en: The London High Court further specified that Chinese law governs victims' claims to the 61,000 BTC (about $5bn/£3.8bn); victims' lawyers plan to appeal and ownership will be decided later.

dormant.title_zh: Federated Hermes计划于明年年初首次发行代币化基金份额
dormant.title_en: Federated Hermes计划于明年年初首次发行代币化基金份额
dormant.latest_update_zh: 管理着9110亿美元资产的Federated Hermes表示，将于明年初与数字证券基础设施提供商Prometheum合作，首次发行代币化基金份额，货币市场基金可能成为首批产品之一。
dormant.latest_update_en: Federated Hermes, a $911 billion asset manager, said it will issue tokenized fund shares for the first time early next year in partnership with digital securities infrastructure provider Prometheum, with money market funds possibly among the first products.

dormant.title_zh: Bybit 推出美股与 ETF 交易并开发代币化股票产品 mStocks
dormant.title_en: Bybit Expands Beyond Crypto With Direct Access to U.S. Stocks & ETFs
dormant.latest_update_zh: Bybit CEO Ben Zhou 宣布，Bybit 股票交易未来将支持股票作为交易抵押品、推出股票借贷服务，并支持从富途、Moomoo 等券商转仓。
dormant.latest_update_en: Bybit CEO Ben Zhou announced that Bybit stock trading will in the future support stocks as trading collateral, offer stock lending services, and enable transfers in from brokers such as Futu and Moomoo.

dormant.title_zh: 迪拜VARA批准Kraken母公司Payward运营，Kraken随后在迪拜上线
dormant.title_en: Dubai VARA Approves Kraken Parent Payward, Kraken Subsequently Launches in Dubai
dormant.latest_update_zh: Kraken在获得虚拟资产监管局（VARA）的全面市场批准后已在迪拜开展业务，将其受监管业务版图扩展至阿联酋。
dormant.latest_update_en: Kraken has launched operations in Dubai after receiving full market approval from the Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA), expanding its regulated footprint into the UAE.

dormant.title_zh: Blur 宣布关闭网站前端并停止匹配新 Blend 贷款
dormant.title_en: Blur to Shut Down Website Frontend and Stop Matching New Blend Loans
dormant.latest_update_zh: Blur宣布将于11月12日关闭其网站前端，并停止Blend匹配新的NFT贷款，此举引发收藏者的欢呼，他们认为其免版税模式和代币激励损害了NFT市场。
dormant.latest_update_en: Blur announced it will shut down its website frontend on Nov. 12 and stop Blend from matching new NFT loans, prompting cheers from collectors who blame its royalty-free model and token incentives for damaging the NFT market.

dormant.title_zh: Meta发布Muse Wonder与Muse Wonder Full前沿AI模型
dormant.title_en: Meta releases Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full frontier AI models

dormant.title_zh: Coinbase 获 CFTC 批准将指数期货转换为永续合约并完成 Deribit 整合
dormant.title_en: Coinbase Completes Deribit Integration
dormant.latest_update_zh:
Coinbase 已获得美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）的衍生品清算组织注册资格，从而可以清算美国衍生品交易。该注册依据《商品交易法》第 5b 条，在公司提交申请并经过审查后获批。

该注册使 Coinbase 能够自行清算其衍生品交易，而不再依赖第三方清算机构，从而为其受美国监管的衍生品业务补上清算环节。据有关该批准的报道，CFTC 将注册范围限定为全额抵押的期货、期货期权和掉期，杠杆类产品不在此列。

Coinbase Derivatives 自称是一个以加密资产为核心的期货交易所，提供覆盖多种资产类别和合约规模的产品。此次 CFTC 注册属于《商品交易法》第 5b 条下的衍生品清算资格。
dormant.latest_update_en: Coinbase has secured CFTC clearing registration, allowing it to clear US derivatives trades and expand its regulated derivatives business.

dormant.latest_update_en: Samsung announced that Samsung Wallet will offer stablecoin access to eligible Galaxy users in the United States, extending stablecoin functionality to a mass-market consumer wallet.

dormant.title_zh: Compound DAO 提案 582 投票前储备资金购买 COMP 引发授权争议，随后提案 612 拟扩大治理对国库操作的延迟与取消权
dormant.title_en: Compound DAO used protocol reserves to buy $52 million worth of COMP, and delegates call it a mandate breach
dormant.latest_update_zh:
Compound DAO 正在就第 612 号提案进行投票，该提案拟将国库操作的延迟从两天延长至十天，并赋予治理机制取消待执行国库操作的权力。一个与 Humpy 相关联的钱包已投出 175 万枚 COMP 的支持票。

若获通过，该提案将延长治理机制对国库待执行操作作出反应的时间窗口，并新增一项取消权。而来自与 Humpy 相关联钱包的 175 万枚 COMP 支持票——Compound 社区此前曾指控该持有者策划治理攻击——使这一新权力直接面临集中度方面的担忧。

投票仍在进行中，因此尚未确认是否通过。该提案同时涉及更长的执行延迟和由治理控制的待执行国库操作取消权。
dormant.latest_update_en:
Compound DAO is voting on Proposal 612, which would extend the delay on treasury operations from two days to ten and grant governance the power to cancel pending treasury actions. A wallet linked to Humpy has cast 1.75 million COMP votes in support of the proposal.

If approved, the proposal would lengthen the window in which governance can react to pending treasury actions and add a new cancellation power. The 1.75 million COMP votes backing it from a wallet tied to Humpy — a holder the Compound community has previously accused of engineering a governance attack — place concentration concerns directly on that new power.

The vote is still in progress, so passage is not confirmed. The measure covers both the longer execution delay and governance-controlled cancellation of pending treasury operations.
